Ka igkarangeb ne baseen ni

The second document by

Samwil

Samwil

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka Ikarangeb ne Samwil, sumpul te An-anayan ne Samwil. Seini ka guhuren te peghari ni Dabid: te an-anayan, diye sikandin migmandu te Huda ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile, (Kapitulu 1–4) wey nataman diyad e te intiru ne nasud, lagkes ka Israil ne diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile (Kapitulu 5–24). Naay-ayaran te egguhud ka seini ne guhuren ne meyitenged ke immenu ni Dabid te pegpakig-ehet te me kuntere din diye te seled te nasud wey diye te duma ne me nasud eyew egmaluag ka migharian din wey eyew egmaresen ka peghari din. Impahunsiling si Dabid ne sabeka ne etew ne dakel se pegpalintutuu wey pegtahud te Manama, wey egkateu ne eg-angey te geyinawa te keet-etawan din. Piru minsan pad due, mabulut degma sikandin wey andam ne eggimu te makaalat-halat ne sale eyew egkaangken din ka kandin mismu ne igkeupii wey eg-im-imanen. Piru te impapitew e te Magbebaye ne Manama diye kandin ka sale din pinaahi te prupita te Magbebaye ne Manama ne si Natan, mig-inniyuhan din e ka me sale din wey indawat din ka impeuyan te Manama ne legpad eyew igpaneem-neem kandin.

The Second Samwil, (is a) continuation of First Samwil. This is_the story of the kinging by Dabid: at first, he ruled in Huda that's facing south (LIT right of line), (Chapters 1–4) and then there to the entire nation, including the Israil which was in the north (LIT on the left of east) (Chapters 5–24). This story was carefully told that concerning how Dabid fought his enemies there within the nation and there to the other nations so_that his kingdom become_wide and so_that his kinging become_strong. Dabid represented (as) one person who has big faith and respect of God (MS Manama), and know (how) to_get the breath of his people. But even of that, he's also fierce and ready to do terrible sin in_order to_get his own desire and (what he) hope. But when the Lord God showed to him his sin by_means of prophet of the Lord God who was Natan, he turned_back his sins and he accepted the punishment that God sent in_order (for) him to experience.

Ka peg-ugpe wey keupianan ne neyimu ni Dabid, amana ne nakapamula diye te pusung wey suman-suman te me Hibruwanen. Purisu te timpu ne inggingumaan te mangune-kune ne keyirapan ka nasud, wey te timpu ne egkeupian e man-e sikandan te lein ne Hari, iyan dan igkeupii ka etew ne anak ni Dabid, ke sikanta pa, kabuhalan ni Dabid ne egpekeiling ded iya kandin.

The living and goodness that Dabid did, were planted very much to the heart and mind of Hibruwanons. Therefore when the time that the severe hardship came to the nation, and when the time that they want another king again, what they want was the person who was Dabid's son, for us(incl) it's, descendant of Dabid that will_become_like him indeed.

Ka pegpataha ki Dabid ne migpatey e si Saul

The informing of Dabid that Saul had died

11 Te migpatey e si Saul, miglibed e si Dabid duma te me duma rin diye te Siklag te natalu ran e ka me Amalikanen. Ne diye pad sikandan mig-uugpe te Siklag te tatelu ne aldew. 2 Te igkatelu e ne aldew, due lukes-lukes ne migginguma puun te kampu ni Saul ne migkukumbale te nahisi wey due alinepung te ulu rin isip palinneu te peglungku. Te pegginguma te seeye ne lukes-lukes diye ki Dabid, miglangkeb e sikandin diye te tangkaan din isip pegtahud kandin. 3 Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Dabid, “Hendei ka migpuun?”

11 When Saul died, Dabid with his company went_back to Siklag when they defeated the Amalikanons. And they stayed at Siklag for two days. 2 On the third day, there_was a young_man that arrived from the camp of Saul that wore a torn cloth and (his) head dusty as a sign of mourning. When this young_man arrived at Dabid, he lay_face_down in front of Dabid as (a way of) respecting him. 3 And he was_asked by Dabid, “Where have you(sg) come_from?”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Migpallahuy a puun te kampu te me matig-Israil.”4 Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Pangguhuri a ke nekey ka neyitabu.”

And he answered, “I ran from the camp of the (ones) from_Israil.”4 And Dabid said, “Story me (about) what's happened.”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Nenakapallahuy ka me matig-Israil ne me sundalu puun te gira, wey masulug ka migpatey. Ne namatey degma minsan si Saul wey ka anak din ne si Diyunatan.”

And he answered, “The (ones) from_Israil soldiers fled(pl) from the war, and many were_killed. And Saul and his child Diyunatan were also dead.”

5 Ne mig-insaan e man-e sikandin ni Dabid, “Immenu nu te egpakataha te namatey e si Saul wey ka anak din ne si Diyunatan?”

5 And he was_asked by Dabid, “How do you(sg) know about the death of Saul and his child Diyunatan?”

6 [xr]Ne migtabak sikandin, “Nakasalengan te diya a te Bubungan te Gilbuwa wey nakita ku si Saul ne migpanukaddel naan de te deldeg din. Ne suble e ne marani kandin ka me kuntere din ne migmangudde wey migmanguntud te karwahi. 7 Te peglilingey rin, nakita a nikandin wey in-umew ad nikandin. Ne migtabak a, ‘Nekey-a ahalen?’ 8 Ne mig-insaan a nikandin, ‘Hentew kaa?’ Ne migtabak a, ‘Amalikanen a.’ 9 Ne ingkahiyan a nikandin, ‘Parani ka ubag keddi, wey himatayi ad su nabaybayaran ad te masakit wey egkeupian ad ne egpatey.’ 10 Purisu imparaniyan ku sikandin wey innimatayan kud su nakanengneng a ne kenad e sikandin egkeuyag tenged te me pali din. Ne ingkuwa kud e ka kuruna rin wey ka bakelew rin, wey in-uyan kud e kayi te keykew ahalen.”

6 [xr]And he answered, “During I was at the Mountain of Gilbuwa and I saw Saul just standing_supported_himself on his spear. And his enemies on_horseback and riding carts/chariots were very close to him. 7 On his turning_around, I was_seen by_him and I was called by_him. And I answered, ‘What master?’ 8 And I was_asked by_him, ‘Who are you(sg)?’ And I answered, ‘I'm an Amalikanon.’ 9 And I was_told by_him, ‘Come_here(sg) please, and kill me because I'm suffering in pain and I want to die.’ 10 Therefore I approached him and I killed him because I knew that he wouldn't live due to his wounds. And I took his crown and his forearm's_bracelet, and I brought it here to you(sg) master.”

11 Ne inggisi ni Dabid ka kumbale din, wey impanggisi degma te me etew rin ka me kumbale dan. 12 Ne migsinehew sikandan wey migpandalawit, wey ware migmangeen taman te nasagkup e tenged ki Saul wey te anak din ne si Diyunatan, wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne keet-etawan te Manama ne nammatey te gira.

11 And Dabid ripped his clothing, and his people also ripped their clothings. 12 They cried(pl) and wailed(pl), and didn't eat until dusk due to Saul and his child Diyunatan, and due to the descendants of Israil who (are) the people of God that died(pl) at war.

13 Ne mig-insaan e man-e ni Dabid ka lukes-lukes ne migpangguhud kandin, “Hendei ka mig-ugpe?”

13 And the young_man who storied to_them was_asked again by Dabid, “Where do you(sg) live?”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Anak a te lapu ne mig-ugpe kayi te inged niyu. Sabeka a ne Amalikanen.”14 Ne mig-insaan e man-e sikandin ni Dabid, “Mania te ware ka naaldek ne eggimatey te in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama?” 15 Ne in-umew e ni Dabid ka sabeka te me sundalu rin wey ingkahiyan, “Himatayi nu sikandin!” Purisu intibbas en iya te sundalu rin ka Amalikanen wey migpatey e. 16 Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Sikeykew red ka egkasenditan te kamatayen nu su sikeykew mismu ka migpamalehet te pegkeetew nu te pegkahi nu te inggimatayan nu ka in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

And he answered, “I (am) the child of a foreigner that lives here in your(pl) place. I'm an Amalikanon.”14 And Dabid asked him, “Why weren't you(sg) afraid to kill the (one) chosen by the Lord God?” 15 And Dabid called one of his soldiers and told_him, “Kill(sg) him!” Therefore the Amalikanon was slashed by his soldier and died. 16 And Dabid said, “You(sg) just the (one) to be blamed of your(sg) death because you(sg) yourself (are) the (one who) gave_evidence about your(sg) self when you(sg) said that you(sg) killed the (one) chosen by the Lord God.”

The song by Dabid of mourning

17 Dabid made a song of mourning about Saul and his child Jonathan, 18 [xr]and he commanded that it be_taught to the people of Huda. And it's named a Song of Arrow, and this was_written in the Book by Yasar. And it went,

Masulug ka mabbantug ne me kuntere dan

ne impangimatayan dan.

wey migpeunungey sikandan se daruwa taman te kamatayen.

and the (one who) put gold decorations on you(pl).

25 “The heroes have_been_exterminated in the fighting_place.

Ne namatey si Diyunatan diye te me bubungan niyu.

And Diyunatan was_killed on your(pl) mountains.

Ka peghari ni Dabid

The kinging by Dabid

21 Nataman, mig-inse si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama ne migkahi, “Egtakereg e naa diye te sabeka te me siyudad te Huda?”

21 Then, Dabid asked the Lord God and said, “Shall I ascend there to one of the cities of Huda?”

Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye, “Uya.”

And the Lord God answered, “Yes.”

Ne mig-inse e man-e si Dabid, “Hendei lenged?”

And Dabid asked again, “Where abouts?”

Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye, “Diye te Hibrun.”2 [xr]Purisu migtakereg e si Dabid duma te daruwa ne duwey rin ne si Ahinuwam ne matig-Hisril wey si Abigil ne impamalu rin ki Nabal ne matig-Karmil. 3 Ne induma ni Dabid ka me etew rin duma te me pamilya ran wey diyad sikandan nangugpe te me lungsud te Hibrun. 4 [xr]Ne migmangendiye te Hibrun ka me matig-Huda wey mig-itisan dan e te lana ka ulu ni Dabid eyew egkeyimu ne Hari te intiru ne Huda.

The Lord God answered, “To Hibrun.”2 [xr]Therefore Dabid ascended along_with his two junior_wives Ahinuwam from_Hisril and Abigil his married_widow of Nabal from_Karmil. 3 Dabid took_along his people along_with their families and they lived(pl) there in the towns of Hibrun. 4 [xr]And the (ones) from_Huda went_there to Hibrun and they poured oil on the head of Dabid in_order to become king of entire Huda.

Te impangguhuran dan e si Dabid te iyan miglebeng ki Saul ka me matig-Habis-Gilyad,5 migsuhu e si Dabid te egpahuhuren din eyew egpakahiyan ka me matig-Habis, “Egpanalanginan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te keupiya niyu te ahalen niyu ne si Saul pinaahi te peglebeng kandin. 6 Ne meupiya perem ne igpapitew te Magbebaye ne Manama ka geyinawa rin ne kene egkabalbalawan wey ka pegkamatinumanen din due te kaniyu. Ne eg-upianan ku sikaniyu tenged te peggimu niyu rue. 7 Ne kuntee, nekal-nekal kew wey kene kew paliliyas tenged su migpatey e si Saul ne ahalen niyu, wey mig-itisan ad te me matig-Huda te lana isip Hari dan.”

When they told Dabid that the (people) from_Habis-Gilyad were the (ones) who had buried Saul,5 Dabid sent someone_to_tell in_order to tell the (ones) from_Diyabis, “(May) you(pl) be blessed by the Lord God for your(pl) goodness to your(pl) master Saul by_means of burying him. 6 And may the Lord God show his unchangeable love and his righteousness to you(pl). And I will_do good to you(pl) due to your(pl) doing that. 7 Therefore now/today, be_strong(pl) and don't be_fearful(pl) because your(pl) master Saul has died, and I've been had oil poured on me by the (ones) from_Huda as their king.”

Ka pegpeehetey te pamilya ni Dabid wey ni Saul

The fighting_each_other of the families of Dabid and Saul

8 Te seeye ne timpu, si Abnir ne anak ni Nir ne pangulu te me sundalu ni Saul, miggendiye te Mahanaim duma te anak ni Saul ne si Isbusit. 9 Ne inggimu rin ne Hari si Isbusit diye te inged ne Gilyad, Ashuri, Hisril, Ipraim, Binhamin, wey diye te intiru ne Israil. 10 Hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un ka idad ni Isbusit te migbunsud sikandin ka mighari te Israil. Ne mighari sikandin te daruwa ne leg-un.

8 At that time, Abnir the child of Nir a leader of the soldiers of Saul, went to the place/village of Mahanaim along_with Isbusit the child of Saul. 9 And he made Isbusit king there in the place/village(s) of Gilyad, Ashuri, Hisril, Ipraim, Binhamin, and there in entire Israil. 10 Isbusit was forty (40) years (old) when beginning reigning Israil. And he reigned for two years.

Piru si Dabid ded ka in-iila ne Hari te me matig-Huda.11 Ne mighari si Dabid diye te Huda te pitu ne leg-un wey hen-em ne bulan, te timpu ne diye sikandin mig-ugpe te Hibrun.

But Dabid was still the (one) recognized as king by the (ones) from_Huda.11 And Dabid reigned in Huda for (LIT inside) seven years and six months, at the time that he lived there in/at Hibrun.

12 Nataman, miggendiye si Abnir ne anak ni Nir te Gibyun puun te Mahanaim duma te me etew ni Isbusit. 13 Ne insinug-ung sikandan ni Huwab ne anak ni Siruya wey te me etew ni Dabid diye te inlungag ne limuranan te weyig diye te Gibyun, wey migpatalipahey sikandan ka naminnuu diye te ilis te lungag. 14 Ne migkahiyan ni Abnir si Huwab, “Egpeg-eheten ta ka me sundalu ta kayi te tangkaan ta.”

12 Then, Abnir the child of Nir along_with the people of Isbusit went to Gibyun from Mahanaim. 13 And they were met by Huwab the child of Siruya and by the people of Dabid there at the dug that storage of water there in Gibyun, and they sat there at the edge of the dug on_opposite_sides. 14 And Huwab was_told by Abnir, “Let us(incl) fight_together our(incl) soldiers in front of us(incl).”

Ne migtabak si Huwab, “Ne uya!”

And Huwab answered, “Oh yes!”

15 Ne migmanasindeg e ka sapulu wey daruwa te me sundalu ni Isbusit ne me kabuhalan ni Binhamin wey ka sapulu wey daruwa degma ne me sundalu ni Dabid. 16 Ne migpahen-geney ka tagse sabeka te bulbul ran wey migparugsuey e sikandan, sikan naa ka nenekeg-unung sikandan langun. Purisu migngaranan e ka seeye ne inged te Hilkat-Hasurim.[fn] Ka sika ne inged diye te Gibyun.

15 And the twelve of Isbusit's soldiers who_were the descendant of Binhamin stand and also the twelve soldiers of Dabid. 16 Each one grabbed_each_other's hair and they stabbed_each_other, so then they died together. Therefore that place was_named Hilkat-Hasurim.[fn] That place (is) there in Gibyun.

17 Ne mangune-kune ka gira te seeye ne aldew, wey natalu te me etew ni Dabid si Abnir wey ka me matig-Israil. 18 Ne diye langun ka tatelu ne anak ni Siruya ne ensi Huwab, Abisay, wey si Asahil duma te sundalu ni Dabid. Si Asahil amana ne iiyali ne egpallahuy iling te usa, 19 wey ware din peen-enengi te eglupug si Abnir. 20 Ne miglilingey si Abnir wey mig-inse, “Sikeykew sika Asahil?”

17 The war was terrible on that day, and the people of Dabid defeated Abnir and the (ones) from_Israil. 18 The three children of Siruya who were Huwab, Abisay, and Asahil were there together_with the soldiers of Dabid. Asahil was very fast at running like a deer, 19 and he didn't cease in chasing Abnir. 20 And Abnir turned_his_head and asked, “Is that you(sg) Asahil?”

Ne migtabak si Asahil, “Uya, sikeddiey.”

And Asahil answered, “Yes, I am.”

21 Ne migkahi si Abnir, “Suwey kad e wey dakep kad e te sabeka te me sundalu wey kua nu ka me panganiban din.” Piru ware migpeeneng-eneng si Asahil ka eglupug kandin. 22 Ne migkahiyan e man-e ni Abnir si Asahil, “Peen-enengi ad iya nikeykew te eglupug su eyew kena a egkapehes ne eggimatey keykew! Egmenuwen ku naan de iya te eg-atubang ka suled nu ne si Huwab?” 23 Piru ware migpeeneng-eneng si Asahil ka miglupug kandin, sikan naa ka insundang e ni Abnir te subeng te deldeg din si Asahil wey mig-abas seini diye te peka rin. Napeled sikandin wey namatey e. Ne egsanggel diye te namatayan ni Asahil ka me etew ne egpakabaye dutu.

21 And Abnir said, “Turn_aside and capture(sg) one of the soldiers and take(sg) his weapons.” But Asahil didn't cease from chasing him. 22 And Asahil was spoken to again by Abnir, “Cease(sg) from chasing me so_that I won't be forced to kill you(sg)! How would I then face Huwab who is your(sg) brother?” 23 But Asahil didn't cease from chasing him, so then Abnir stabbed Asahil with his spear and it went_through to his back. He fell and died. And the people passing_by there stopped at the dying_place of Asahil.

24 Piru inlupug mule enni Huwab wey ni Abisay si Abnir. Te eglineb e ka aldew, nekeume e sikandan diye te bubungan te Ama ne lenged te Giya, ne diye te dalan peendiye te disirtu diye te Gibyun. 25 Ne miglibulung ka me sundalu ne kabuhalan ni Binhamin diye te keinniyuhan ni Abnir diye te puntul te bubungan wey migpangandam eyew te pegbubunu. 26 Ne mig-inse si Abnir ki Huwab ne migpanguleyi, “Egpahiggireey ki naan en iya te ware egtamanan? Ware ke buwa nakasuman-suman te susumpiti ka egpangkusan kayi? Ken-u nu naan pad egsapari ka me etew nu ne egpanlupug te me suled dan?”

24 But Huwab and Abisay on_the_contrary chased Abnir. When the sun set, they arrived at the mountain of Ama near Giya, which there to the path going to the desert at Gibyun. 25 And the soldiers who_were the descendants of Binhamin gathered behind Abnir there on the top of the mountain and prepared for fighting. 26 And Huwab asked shouting_at by Abnir, “Will we(incl) just continue_warring without ending? Aren't you(sg) think that this outcome is terrible? When will_ you(sg) _scold your(sg) people from chasing their siblings/cousins?”

27 Ne migtabak si Huwab, “Igpahunlibet ku te manekal ne Manama, ne emun ke ware nu lalaha sika, egparahasdahasan kew iya perem te eglupug te me etew ku taman te egkapawe.” 28 Purisu imparahing e ni Huwab ka trumpita wey migpeeneng-eneng e ka langun ne miglupug te me matig-Israil, wey nasanggel e ka gira.

27 And Huwab said, “I swear to the living God, that if you(sg) hadn't said that, you(pl) would have continued to_have_been_chased by my people until dawn.” 28 Therefore Huwab had_ the trumpet _sounded and all who were pursuing the (ones) from_Israil ceased, and the warring stopped.

29 Ne miggipanew si Abnir duma te me sundalu rin te napawaan peendiye te Araba. Ne miglapas sikandan te Weyig ne Hurdan wey migpabulus ka miggipanew ne diye migbaye te inged ne Bitrun taman te nekeuma sikandan diye te Mahanaim.

29 And Abnir and his soldiers traveled until dawn going_towards Araba. And they crossed the Jordan River and they continued to travel passing_through the territory of Bitrun until they arrived there at Mahanaim.

30 Te migpeeneng-eneng e si Huwab ka egpanlupug ki Abnir, impalibulung din e ka me etew rin. 31 Seeye ka bunsuranan te naluhey ne pegpeehetey te miglapig te pamilya ni Saul wey te miglapig ki Dabid. Ne nanasnasian ne migmasalig ka me etew ne miglapig ki Dabid piru nahan-ganaran mule migdeisek ka me etew ne eglapig ki Saul.

We(excl) will_make an agreement but there_is one thing_ I _request from_him: it's_ not _possible that he will_see/meet me if he don't accompany Mikal the child of Saul.” 14 [xr]And Dabid also sent his servants to Isbusit the child of Saul in_order for saying, “Return(sg) my spouse Mikal because I killed one hundred (100) (people_who_were) Pilistihanons and I cut_off the skin of their bottoms as bride_price for my marrying her.” 15 And Isbusit commanded that Mikal be_taken from her spouse the child of Lais named Paltiil. 16 But the spouse of Mikal just accompanied crying as (he) followed her until Bahurim. 26 Ne mig-awe e si Huwab puun te tangkaan ni Dabid, wey impalupug din e te me etew si Abnir. 41 Te pegkarineg ni Isbusit ne anak ni Saul te inggimatayan si Abnir diye te Hibrun, migmahuye e sikandin wey nalliyasan degma ka langun ne matig-Israil. 2 Ne due daruwa ne etew ni Isbusit ne si Baana wey si Rikab ne migpangulu te pegpanlusud te me kuntere dan. (Seini se Biirut in-ile e ne sakup te Binhamin 3 tenged su namallahuy ma diye te Gitaim ka tapey ne nangugpe dutu wey diyad e sikandan miglapu taman kuntee.)

41 When Ibusit the child of Saul heard that Abnir had been_killed in Hibrun, he lost hope and all the (ones) from_Israil were also afraid(pl). 2 There were two people of Isbusit that (were) Baana and Rikab who led in invading their enemies. They were the children of Rimun from_Biirut from the descendants of Binhamin. (This Biirut is known now under_the_jurisdiction of Binhamin 3 because the people from here long_ago fled to Gitaim and they migrated there until now/today.)

4 [xr]Ne duen pad man-e kabuhalan ni Saul ne si Mipibusit ne anak ni Diyunatan angin e ki Isbusit. Ne tenged dutu, insapipi e sikandin te malitan ne talaggaat kandin wey migpallahuy e, piru nalekaan ka bate te talaggaat tenged te peg-iyal-iyal rin. Ne seeye ka egpuunan ne napungku ka me paa te bate.

4 [xr]Saul had a another child aside_from Isbusit who was Mipibusit who was the child of Diyunatan. And due to it, he was_carried_in_arms by the woman who was_looking_after him and ran, but due to her speed the child was_let_go. That's the reason that why the child became_lame of feet.

5 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye te baley ni Isbusit si Rikab wey si Baana ne me anak ni Rimun ne matig-Biirut. Inggimatayan dan sikandin wey intamped dan e ka ulu rin wey in-uyan dan e te mig-ayun ne migpallahuy. Ne migsigpawe sikandan ka miggipanew peendiye te inged ne Hurdan. 8 Ne in-uyan dan ka ulu ni Isbusit diye ki Dabid diye te Hibrun wey migkahi, “Hari, seini red ka ulu ni Isbusit ne anak ni Saul ne egkuntere keykew wey ka egkeupian ne eggimatey keykew. Ne kuntee ne aldew, migsulian e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Saul wey ka me kabuhalan din tenged te neyimu ran keykew te ahalen ney wey Hari.”

5 One day, Rikab and Baana the children of Rimun from_Biirut went to the house of Isbusit. They arrived when the sun was overhead while Isbusit was resting. 6-7 At that time, they entered the house that pretending to get wheat. And they stabbed Isbusit in his stomach, while he was lying down in his room. And they killed him and cut his head and they departed taking it and running_away. And they walked towards the place of Hurdan all_night. 8 And they took the head of Isbusit to Dabid there at Hibrun and said, “King, here is the head of Isbusit the child of Saul your(sg) enemy and the (one who) wanted to kill you(sg). Today, the Lord God has revenged Saul and his descendants due to what_ they _did to you(sg) our(excl) master and king.”

9 Piru intabak ni Dabid ka tahasuled ne ensi Rikab wey Baana, “Egpahunlibet a te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama ne iyan migpangabang keddi te langun ne me kalasayan! 10 [xr]Due sabeka ne etew dengan ne migkahi, ‘Migpatey e si Saul,’ wey migsuman-suman sikandin ne meupiya ne guhuren ka impangguhud din keddi. Piru nasi ku re iya sikandin iparakep wey impeyimatayan diye te Siklag. Impanempug dan ka me belad dan wey me paa ran, wey imbitin dan e ka me lawa ran diye te ilis te inlungag ne limuranan te weyig diye te Hibrun. 9 But the siblings Rikab and Baana were_answered by Dabid, “I swear to the strong/living Lord God who rescued me in all difficulties! 10 [xr]There_was one person before who said, ‘Saul is dead,’ and he thought that it was a good story that he brought to_me. Purisu, mighari sikandin te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un langun.

51 All the tribes of Israil went to Dabid at Hibrun and said, “We(excl) are very close relatives of you(sg). 2 In past times, when Saul was still our(excl) king, you(sg) were the (one who) led the (ones) from_Israil in fighting. The Lord God said to you(sg), ‘You(sg) (are) the (one who) will_care_for[fn] my people the (ones) from_Israil and you(sg) will_become their leader.’ ” 3 Therefore at that time, Dabid made an agreement again with all the elders of Israil there in_front of the Lord God. The leaders poured oil on the head of Dabid as king of Israil. 4 [xr]The age of Dabid when the time he became king of Israil was thirty (30) and he reigned for forty (40) years. 5 And he kinged there in Huda for seven years and six months at the time that he lived there in/at Hibrun. Then, he kinged there in Israil and Huda thirty three (33) years at the time that he lived there in/at Hirusalim. Therefore, he reigned forty (40) years in all.

Ka pegkaahew ni Dabid te Hirusalim

The snatching of Hirusalim by Dabid

6 [xr]Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye si Dabid wey ka me etew rin te Hirusalim eyew te peglusud te me kabuhalan ni Hibus ne mig-ugpe diye. Ne migkahiyan si Dabid te me Hibusihanen, “Kene kew iya egpakaseled kayi te Hirusalim. Iyan niyu re eleg se egbalabahan te me butud wey me piang.” Ne kahiyen dan ne kene iya egpakaseled ensi Dabid. 7 Piru minsan pad due, naahew red enni Dabid ka malig-en ne inged ne iyan ka Hirusalim,[fn] ne nataman ingngaranan e te Siyudad ni Dabid.

6 [xr]One day, Dabid and his people went to Hirusalim in_order for invading the descendants of Hibus who lived there. And Dabid was_told by the Hibusihanons, “You(pl) won't be_able_to_enter here in Hirusalim. Only the blind and the crippled will_ just _prevent you(pl).” They thought that Dabid and_company really couldn't enter. 7 But despite that, Dabid and_company just snatched the strong/fortified place which is Hirusalim,[fn] and then it was_named the City of Dabid.

8 Te sika ne aldew migkahiyan ni Dabid ka me etew rin, “Minsan hentew seeye se eglusud te me kabuhalan ni Hibus, diye sikandin egbaye te impabayaan te weyig eyew te pegpangimatey te sika se me butud wey me piang ne me kuntere ku!” Sikan naa ka due lalag ne miggenendue, “Kene egpakaseled ka me butud wey me lepu diye te timplu.”

8 On that day Dabid said to his people, “Whoever invades the descendants of Hibus, he will_go_via the water way in_order for killing those blind and crippled enemies of mine!” That's why there_is a saying that goes, “The blind and the fractured can't enter the temple.”

9 Te naahew e ni Dabid ka malig-en ne inged te Hirusalim, diyad e sikandin mig-ugpe wey ingngaranan din e seini te Siyudad ni Dabid. Ne impeyiluahan din pad ka siyudad puun te Milu[fn] peendiye te palasyu. 10 Ne nanas-nasian pad ka karesen ni Dabid su migduma ma kandin ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye.

9 When Dabid snatched the strong place of Hirusalim, he lived there and he named it the City of Dabid. And he expanded the city from Milu[fn] towards the palasyu. 10 And the strength of Dabid even_grew because the Very Powerful Lord God accompanied him.

11 Ne migsuhu ka Hari te Tiru ne si Hiram te me suluhuanen din peendiye ki Dabid duma te me talagbebaley wey talagperi te me batu. Ne mig-uyan sikandan te me terusu ne kayu ne sidar eyew eggimuwan si Dabid te palasyu. 12 Ne nanengnengan ni Dabid ne ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka miggimu kandin ne Hari te Israil wey ka amana migpanalangin te migharian din para te keupianan te keet-etawan din ne me matig-Israil.

11 And Hiram the king of Tiru commanded servants (to go) there to Dabid along_with builders and splitters of stone. And they brought beams of cedar wood in_order for making a palace for Dabid. 12 And Dabid realized that the Lord God was the (one who) made him king of Israil and the (one who) blessed his kingdom greatly for the peace/prosperity of his people from_Israil.

13 Te nakaalin e si Dabid diye te Hirusalim puun te Hibrun, migduruwey pad sikandin wey migpangasawa pad te masalig ne me malitan ne matig-Hirusalim. Ne migmasalig pad ka me lukes wey me malitan ne me anak din. 14 Seini ka me ngaran te me lukes ne anak din ne neneetew diye te Hirusalim: si Samwa, si Subab, si Natan, si Sulumun, 15 si Ibhar, si Ilisuwa, si Nipig, si Hapiya, 16 si Ilisama, si Ilyada, wey si Ilipilit.

13 When Dabid had_finished moving to Hirusalim from Hibrun, he took_junior_wife(s) and he also married(pl) many girls from_Hirusalim. And his male and female children increased more. 14 These (are) the names of his male children who were_born in Hirusalim: Samwa, Subab, Natan, Sulumun, 15 Ibhar, Ilisuwa, Nipig, Hapiya, 16 Ilisama, Ilyada, and Ilipit.

Natalu ni Dabid ka me Pilistihanen

Dabid defeated the Pilistihanons

(1 Kru 14:8‑17)

(1 Chr 14:8‑17)

17 Te pegkanengnengi te me Pilistihanen ne si Dabid ka in-alam ne Hari te Israil, nanakereg e sikandan langun eyew te pegdakep ki Dabid. Piru nanengnengan seeye ni Dabid, sikan naa ka miggendiyad e sikandin te aputanan ne inged. 18 Ne miggingume e ka me Pilistihanen wey migtalagtag e diye te napu te Ripaim. 19 Purisu mig-inse si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Eglusuran ku naa ka me Pilistihanen? Igpareeg nu naa sikandan keddi?”

17 When the (ones) Pilistihanons found_out that Dabid was the (one) chosen as king of Israil, they all ascended(pl) in_order to capture him. But Dabid found_out about this, so then he went to a refuge place. 18 And the (ones) Pilistihanons arrived in the plain at Ripaim and they spread_out in camping. 19 Therefore Dabid asked the Lord God, “Shall I invade the (ones) Pilistihanons? Will you(sg) cause_ them _to_be_defeated by me?”

Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Uya, hipanew kad su igpareeg ku iya sikandan keykew.”

And the Lord God answered, “Yes, go(sg) because I will_ indeed _cause_ them _to_be_defeated by_you(sg).”

20 Purisu miggendiyad ensi Dabid te Baal-Pirasim wey nareeg dan ka me Pilistihanen diye. Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Imparereetan keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me kuntere ku iling te nabusaye ne weyig.” Sikan naa ka ingngaranan ka sika ne inged te Baal-Pirasim.[fn] 21 Ne neengkeran e te me Palistihanen ka me diyus-diyus dan diye, wey in-uyan e seeye enni Dabid wey te me etew rin.

20 Therefore Dabid and_company went to Baal-Pirasim and they defeated the (ones) Pilistihanons there. And Dabid said, “The Lord God caused_ me _to_destroy my enemies like the water burst_out.” That's why that place was_named Baal-Pirasim.[fn] 21 And the (ones) Pilistihanons deserted their gods there, and these were_taken by Dabid and his people.

22 Ne nataman, nanlibed e man-e ka me Pilistihanen diye te napu te Ripaim wey migtalagtag e man-e sikandan diye. 23 Sikan naa ka mig-inse e man-e si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye ne miggenendue, “Kene kew baye diye te egkatangkaan dan ka eglusud, ke kene, alingkus kew diye te egkeinniyuhan dan wey diye kew naa pangandam ka eglusud kandan te talipag ne marani te me kayu ne balsamu. 24 Emun ke egkarineg niyu ka egwekes-wekes diye te uud te me kayu ne balsamu, lusud kew naan e su sika ka ilaan ne miggun-a a kaniyu te eglusud te me Pilistihanen.” 25 Purisu inggimu ni Dabid ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama kandin wey impangimatayan dan ka me Pilistihanen puun te Giba taman te Gisir.

22 And then, the (ones) Pilistihanons returned(pl) there in the plain of Ripaim and they spread_out again there. 23 So then Dabid asked the Lord God again. And the Lord God replied going, “Don't(pl) attack by passing_by in front of them, but rather, go(pl)_around and attack them there on the facing_side of the balsamu trees. 24 When you(pl) hear the noises there in the top of the balsamu trees, attack(pl) then because that's the sign the I have preceded you(pl) for attacking the (ones) Pilistihanons.” 25 Therefore Dabid did what_ the Lord God _commanded him and they killed the (ones) Pilistihanons from Giba until Gisir.

Ka peg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te Hirusalim

The carrying of the Container of the Agreement to Hirusalim

(1 Kru 13:1‑14; 15:25–16:6, 4 15:25–16:6, 43)

(1 Chr 13:1‑14; 15:25–16:6, 4 15:25–16:6, 43)

61 Ne inlibulung e man-e ni Dabid ka langun ne mangngateu ne me sundalu te Israil, ne tatelu ne pulu ne libu (30,000) ka kasuluhan. 2 [xr]Ne nangendiye sikandan te Baali ne sakup te Huda eyew te peg-angey te Tahuanan te Kasabutan ne ingngaranan te ngaran te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye. Ka Magbebaye ne Manama diye migpinnuu te taliware te daruwa ne kirubin diye te ampew te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. 3 [xr]Indulan dan te iyam ne kerumata ka Tahuanan puun te baley ni Abinadab ne diye te bubungan. Ne iyan mig-uyan te kerumata ne ingganuy te me baka ka me anak ni Abinadab ne ensi Usa wey Ahiyu. 4 Ne si Ahiyu ka miggun-a te kerumata. 5 Ne miggale-gale diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Dabid duma te langun ne matig-Israil taman te egkeyimu ran pinaahi te me ulahingen, me lira, me alpa, tambur, me kastanyita, wey me putew ne basalan.

61 And Dabid again gathered all the skilled soldiers of Israil, and the number was thirty thousand (30,000). 2 [xr]And they went_there(pl) to Baali under_the_jurisdiction of Huda in_order for fetching the Container of the Agreement that was_named with the name of the Very Strong Lord. The Lord God sits between the cherubim there on top of the Container of the Agreement. 3 [xr]They cargoed the Container on a new cart from the house of Binadab there on the mountain. And the (ones who) drove (LIT brought) the cart that's pulled by oxens (were) the children of Abinadab who were Usa and Ahiyu. 4 And Ahiyu preceded the cart. 5 And Dabid along_with all the (ones) from_Israil were_very_happy in front of the Lord God as far as they could by_means of songs, lyres, harps, tamburs, kastanyitas, and iron gongs.

6 Te pegginguma ran diye te inged ne diekanan te trigu ni Nakun, inggen-genan ni Usa ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan tenged su nasaligkat ka me baka. 7 Tenged dutu, nabelu amana ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki Usa, sikan naa ka inggimatayan e sikandin te Manama diye te dangdang te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. 8 Nabelu si Dabid tenged su indusaan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Usa. Sikan naa ka ingngaranan ka seeye ne inged te Piris-Usa[fn] taman kuntee. 9 Ne naaldek si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama te seeye ne aldew wey migkahi, “Egmenuwen ku naan e te eg-uyan ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye?” 10 Purisu kenad egkeupian si Dabid ne eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te siyudad din. Sikan naa ka diye din e seini uyana te baley te sabeka ne matig-Gat ne si Ubid-Idum. 11 [xr]Ne diye nakatetahu te baley ni Ubid-Idum ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama te tatelu ne bulan. Ne impanalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Ubid-Idum wey ka tagse sabeka ne diye te baley rin.

6 On their arrival at the place of the wheat treading_place of Nakun, Usa reached up and touched the Container of the Agreement because the cows tripped/stumbled. 7 And due to that, the Lord God was_ very _angry at Usa, that's why God killed him there beside the Container of the Agreement of God. 8 Dabid was angry because Usa was_punished by the Lord God. So then that place was_named Piris-Usa[fn] until now. 9 And Dabid was afraid of the Lord God on that day and said, “How then can I bring the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God?” 10 Therefore Dabid no_longer wanted to bring the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God to his city. So then he brought it to the house of Ubididum one Hitihanon. 11 [xr]And the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God got_put there in the house of Ubidinum for three months. And the Lord God blessed Ubidinum and all at his house.

12 Nahuhuran si Hari Dabid te impanalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka tagse sabeka diye te baley ni Ubid-Idum wey ka langun ne kandin tenged te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama. Sikan naa ka in-angey e seeye ni Dabid diye te baley ni Ubid-Idum wey in-uyan din e diye te siyudad din te nahale-gale. 13 Te nakasikal e te hen-em ne sikal seeye se mig-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama, migpanubad e si Dabid te sabeka ne turu ne baka wey sabeka ne malambeg ne nati ne baka. 14 Ne migsayew si Dabid migpanaman-taman diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Migsesaya sikandin te hinabel ne egngaranan te ipud. 15 Ne migmanguleyi wey migmarahing te me trumpita si Dabid duma te me Israilita te sasangan dan ka eg-uuyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

12 King Dabid was_informed that everyone there in the house of Ubid-Idnum and all he owns were blessed by the Lord God due to the Container of the Agreement of God. So then it was fetched there by Dabid from the house of Ubid-Idum and he brought it to his city along_with joy. 13 When those who were carrying the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God stepped six steps, Dabid sacrificed one bull cow and one fat cow calf. 14 Dabid danced intensely there in front of the Lord God. He wore_a_skirt of cloth named ipud. 15 Therefore Dabid and the (ones) from_Israil brought the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God along_with shouting and sounding of trumpets.

16 Te igpaseled e ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Siyudad ni Dabid, migpantew te bintana ka anak ni Saul ne malitan ne si Mikal. Ne nakita rin si Dabid ne mig-um-umbetut wey migsayew diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne puun dutu, inlemetan din e si Dabid diye te diralem din. 17 Ne impaseled dan e ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te balungbalung ne inggimu ni Dabid para kayi. Ne migpanubad e si Dabid te egtutungen ne igpanubad wey te igpanubad para te keupianan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 18 Te nekeimpus e sikandin ka migpanubad, impanalanginan din e ka me etew pinaahi te ngaran te Amana ne Maresen Magbebaye. 19 [xr]Ne impamehayan din e te paan, te ngalap, wey te egkakeen ne inggimu puun te behas te paras ka langun ne keet-etawan te Israil—me lukes wey me malitan. Ne nataman, nanguli e ka langun ne me etew diye te me ugpaan dan.

16 When the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God taken_inside the City of Dabid, Mikal the female child of Saul looked_out from the window. And she saw Dabid jumping_up_and_down and dancing in front of the Lord God. From that, she mocked Dabid in her inside. 17 And they placed_ the Container of the Agreement _inside the tent that Dabid had made for it. And Dabid sacrificed by burning and he also sacrificed for peace/prosperity there in front of the Lord God. 18 When he finished sacrificing, he blessed the people by_means of the name of the Very Strong Lord. 19 [xr]And he distributed bread, fish/meat, and food made from the fruit of grapevines to all the people of Israil—men and women. And then, all the people returned_home(pl) to their living_places.

20 Te peg-uli ni Dabid eyew te pegpanalangin te pamilya rin, insinug-ung e sikandin ni Mikal ne anak ni Saul te migkahi, “Hari te Israil, amana ka ne mig-ungel-ungel te seini ne aldew! Mekeyilew-hilew ka inggimu nu ne migpalawas diye te tangkaan te me malitan ne suluhuanen te me upisyal nu, iling te etew ne ungel.”

20 On the returning_home of Dabid in_order for blessing his family, he was_met by Mikal the child of Saul who said, “You(sg) king of Israil, you're so naughty this day! What_ you(sg) _did is shameful that's undressed there in_front of the female servants of your(sg) officials, like the foolish person.”

21 Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Inggimu ku seeye diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne mig-alam keddi labew te amey nu wey te minsan hentew te pamilya rin. In-alam a nikandin ne egmandu te keet-etawan din ne me matig-Israil. Sikan naa ka eggale-gale a diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 22 Ne eggimu e pad te subla ne mekeyilew-hilew kayi. Mekeyilew-hilew a te pegtengteng nu[fn] piru intahud a te seeye se me malitan ne egkahiyen nu.”

21 And Dabid said, “I did this in front of the Lord God who chose me above your(sg) father and anyone in his family. I was_chosen by him to rule his people the (ones) from_Israil. That's why I'm enjoying there in front of the Lord God. 22 And what_ I _do will_be_even more embarrassing. I'm shamed in your(sg) sight[fn] but I'm respected by those females that_ you(sg) _were_talking_about.”

23 Ne ware nakaanak si Mikal taman te migpatey sikandin.

23 And Mikal didn't have_children until she died.

Ka lalag te Magbebaye ki Dabid

The word of the Lord to Dabid

(1 Kru 17:1‑15)

(1 Chr 17:1‑15)

71 Ne diyad e mig-ugpe si Dabid te palasyu rin wey warad sikandin palusuri te Magbebaye ne Manama te langun ne egkuntere kandin te minsan hendei. 2 Ne migkahiyan ni Dabid ka prupita ne si Natan, “Kayi ad kuntee mig-ugpe te palasyu ne inggimu puun te kayu ne sidar, piru diye de mule nakatahu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama te balungbalung.”

71 And Dabid lived there in his palace and the Lord God didn't caused_ him _to_be_attacked of all who against him everywhere. 2 And Dabid said to the prophet Natan, “I live here in a palace made from cedar wood, while on_the_contrary the Container of the Agreement of God is just placed in a tent.”

3 Ne migtabak si Natan te Hari, “Himuwa nu ka minsan nekey ne due te suman-suman nu ne igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen su migduma keykew ka Magbebaye ne Manama.” 4 Piru te sika ne marusilem, impanengneng te Magbebaye ne Manama si Natan, 5 “Hendiyei nu ka suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid wey kahii nu te seini ka ingkahi ku, ‘Kene ne sikeykew ka egpasasindeg te baley ne eg-ugpaan ku. 6 Ware e pad nekeugpe te baley bunsud te timpu ne impalihawang ku ka me matig-Israil puun te Ihiptu taman kuntee. Miggalin-halin a te inged wey balungbalung de ka in-ugpaan ku. 7 Te peggalin-halin ku minsan hendei duma te langun ne me matig-Israil, wara a migkahi te me pangulu ran ne impabantey ku te keet-etawan ku te mania te kena a nikaniyu eggimuwan te baley ne puun te kayu ne sidar?’

3 And Natan answered the king, “Do/make whatever is in your(sg) thinking that you(sg) desire to do because the Lord God is accompanying you(sg).” 4 But on that very_night, the Lord God informed Natan, 5 “Go(sg) to my servant Dabid and tell(sg) (him) this that_ I _said, ‘It won't be you(sg) (who is) the (one who) will_build me a house that I will_live_in. 6 I haven't yet lived in a house beginning from the time that I sent_out the (ones) from_Israil out_of Ihiptu until now. I moved_around the place and I just lived_in a tent. 7 When I was repeatedly_moving wherever along_with all the (ones) from_Israil, I didn't say to those leaders that I caused_for_looking_after my people that's why haven't I been_built a house by_you(pl) made of cedar wood?’

8 “Purisu kahii nu ka suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid te migkahi a se Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ‘Talagtameng ka dengan te karniru diye te patabtabanan piru in-alam ku sikeykew ne egkeyimu ne pangulu te keet-etawan ku ne me matig-Israil. 9 Ne indumaan ku sikeykew minsan hendei ka migpabaye wey intalu ku ka langun ne me kuntere nu ne egkabayaan nu. Ne kuntee, eggimuwen ku sikeykew ne mabantug iling te mabantug ne me etew te kalibutan. 10 Egteilan ku te inged ka keet-etawan ku ne matig-Israil wey igpeugpe ku sikandan diye eyew duen e tane dan mismu, wey kenad e sikandan egkahewhew. Ne kenad e egpakareeg-deeg kandan ka me maddeet ne etew iling te inggimu ran dengan 11 bunsud pad te mig-alam a te me pangulu eyew egmandu te keet-etawan ku ne me matig-Israil. Ne kene kud e sikaniyu egpalusuran te langun ne egkuntere kaniyu. Sikeddi se Magbebaye ne Manama, egnangen keykew ne due egkeyimu ne Hari puun te kabuhalan nu. 12 [xr]Ke egpatey kad e wey iglebeng e diye te inlebengan te kabuybuyahan nu, eggimuwen ku ne Hari ka sabeka te anak nu ne me lukes wey eggimuwen ku ne maresen ka migharian din. 13 Sikandin ka eggimu te baley para keddi wey iyan ku iya egpaharien ka me kabuhalan din te ware egtamanan. 14 [xr]Egkeyimu ad ne amey rin, wey egkeyimu e sikandin ne anak ku. Ne egdisiplineen ku sikandin ke egkaseyyup, iling te pegdisiplina te sabeka ne etew te anak din. 15 Piru kene ku eg-aween ka geyinawa ku ne kene egkabalbalawan kandin, kene ne iling te inggimu ku ki Saul ne impasubalan ku keykew. 16 [xr]Ne ware katamanan te migharian nu wey igpahari ku te ware egtamanan ka me kabuhalan nu.’ ” 17 Impangguhud ni Natan ki Dabid ka langun ne impakita te Magbebaye ne Manama kandin.

8 “Therefore tell my servant Dabid that I the Very Strong Lord said, ‘You(sg) were guarding sheep before there in the grazing_place but I chose you(sg) to become a leader of my people the (ones) from_Israil. 9 And I accompanied you(sg) wherever you(sg) went and I defeated all of your(sg) enemies that you(sg) passed_through. So then, now I will_make you(sg) famous like the famous people of the world. 10 I will_set my people of Israil a place and I will_have_ them _live there so_that they have their own land, and they won't be_disturbed again. The bad people will_ no_longer _be_able_to_defeat them like they did before 11 starting when I chose leaders in_order to lead my people that from_Israil(pl). And I'll no_longer caused_you(pl)_to_be_attacked by all whom against you(pl). I the Lord God, would_tell you(sg) that there will_became king from your(sg) descendants. 12 [xr]When you(sg) die and you(sg) are buried at the burial_place of your(sg) elder(s), I will_make one of your(sg) male children king and I will_make his kingdom strong. 13 He will_be_the (one who) will_build a house for me and I indeed caused_ his descendants _to_king without ending. 14 [xr]I will_become his father, and he will_ also _become my child. And I will_discipline him if he errs, like the disciplining by one person of his child. 15 But I won't remove my unchangeable love for_him, not like what_ I _did to Saul whom I caused_to_be_replaced by you(sg). 16 [xr]And there won't be an end to your(sg) kingdom and will_caused your(sg) descendants to_king without ending.’ ” 17 Natan storied Dabid all that the Lord God shown to him.

Ka peg-ampu ni Dabid

The praying of Dabid

(1 Kru 17:16‑27)

(1 Chr 17:16‑27)

18 Ne migseled si Dabid diye te balungbalung ne in-ugpaan te Manama wey migpinnuu ne mig-ampu diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne miggenendue, “Magbebaye ne Manama, sikeddi wey ka pamilya ku kene ne eleg te meupiya ne immangimu nu para kanami. 19 Piru deisek pad seini diye te keykew Magbebaye ne Manama su duen pad iya man-e saad nu ne egpanalanginan nu ka pamilya ku keureme. 121 [xr]Ne impeendiye te Magbebaye ne Manama si prupita Natan ki Dabid. Te pegginguma rin diye ki Dabid, ingguhuran din e sikandin, “Due daruwa ne etew diye te sabeka ne siyudad. Ne iyan din de igpakeen-keen ka pegkeen din wey diye din de egpein-inuma te inumanan din, wey egsapsapipiyen din seini. 5 Ne nabelu-belu amana si Dabid te seeye se meyaman ne etew wey ingkahiyan din si Natan, “Egpahunlibet a te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama, ne eleg ne egpatey ka etew ne miggimu due. 6 Keilangan ne egliwanan din te hep-at ne karniru ka karniru ne ingkuwa rin tenged te inggimu rin wey tenged su ware keyid-u rin.”

Ne impareralu e te Magbebaye ne Manama te mangune-kune ka bate ne anak ni Dabid ki Batsiba ne balu ni Uriyas.16 Purisu migpeyid-u-hid-u si Dabid te Manama para te bate. 20 Ne mig-enew si Dabid puun te tane wey migpamanihus e sikandin, migpamaluhu te lana, wey mig-ilis. Ne miggendiyad sikandin te balungbalung te Magbebaye ne Manama wey migsimba sikandin diye. 22 And he answered, “While the baby was still alive, I fasted and cried because I thought what if the Lord God is still merciful to_me and he doesn't permit that the baby will_die. 23 But now that the baby has died, why would I still fast? (1 Kru 20:1‑3)

(1 Chr 20:1‑3)

26 Ne migbubunu si Huwab diye te Raba, ka siyudad te me Amunihanen wey naahew rin ka siyudad ne in-ugpaan te Hari. 27 Ne migsuhu si Huwab te me etew wey impakahiyan din si Dabid, “Migbubunu a kayi te Raba wey naahew ku ka sebseb ne egsaksakuhan dan te weyig. 28 Purisu libulunga nu kuntee ka nahaat ne me etew wey lusuri niyu ka siyudad wey ahawa niyu seini. Su ke kene, sikeddiey e ka eg-ahew te siyudad wey egngaranan ku seini te ngaran ku.” 29 Purisu inlibulung e ni Dabid ka nasame ne me etew wey miggendiyad te Raba. Ne migbubunu sikandan diye wey naahew ran seini. 30 Ingkuwa ni Dabid ka bulawan ne kuruna puun te ulu te Hari te me Amunihanen[fn] wey ingkukuruna rin e seini. Ne me tatelu ne pulu wey lalimma (35) ne kilu ka kabehat, wey due me mahal ne batu kayi. Ne masulug ka kasangkapan ne nakuwa ni Dabid te seeye ne siyudad. 31 Ne impandakep din e ka me etew te seeye ne siyudad wey inggimu rin sikandan ne talaggabas, talagpiku, wey talagpangguley wey impepangimu rin degma sikandan te tisa. Ne iling ded ka inggimu rin te seeye se me etew diye te langun ne bariyu te me Amunihanen. Ne nanguli e ensi Dabid wey ka langun ne etew diye te Hirusalim.

26 And Huwab fought against Raba, the city of the Amunihanons and he captured the city where the king lived. 27 And Huwab commanded some people and had_ Dabid _told, “I've fought here at Raba and I snatched their fetching_place of water. 28 Therefore gather(sg) the remaining people and invade(pl) the city and snatch(pl) it. Because if not, I will_be_the (one who) will_snatch the city and I will_name it with my name.” 29 Therefore Dabid gather the remaining people and went(pl) to Raba. And they fought there and they snatched it. 30 Dabid took the gold crown from the head of the king of the Amunihanons[fn] and he was crowned_with it. And the weight of it was about thirty five (35) kilograms, and there were expensive stones on it. And Dabid took many possessions from that city. 31 And he accompanied the people of that city and he made them sawyers, pickers, and splitters_of_firewood and he had_ them _make brick(s). And he did like this to those people there to all the barrios of the descendants of Amun. And Dabid and all the people returned_home to Hirusalim.

Ka pegleheng ni Amnun ki Tamar

The raping (LIT embracing) of Tamar by Amnun

131 Ne due mateles ne malitan ne anak ni Dabid ne egngaranan ki Tamar ne atebey ni Absalum. Ne due man-e lukes ne anak ni Dabid te duwey rin ne egngaranan ki Amnun ne naalihan ki Tamar. 2 Piru kene din egkeyimu ka igkeupii rin diye ki Tamar tenged su mengebay mem pad sikandin. Ne tenged kayi, nabaybayaran e sikandin su ware egkeyimu rin taman te migderalu rin e. 3 Ne due alukuy ni Amnun ne egngaranan ki Hunadab ne anak ni Simiyas ne suled ni Dabid ne lukes. Ne subla ne utekan si Hunadab. 4 Ne mig-insaan din si Amnun, “Mania te egkitkiteen ku sikeykew se anak te Hari ne eglungku te tagse maselem? Ne kun pangguhuri a te prublima nu?”

131 And there was beautiful female child of Dabid named Tamar and a sister of Absalum. And Dabid has another male child with his junior_wife named Amnun who desired Tamar. 2 But he couldn't do what_he_want there to Tamar because she was still a maiden. And due to this, he (was) suffered because there was nothing he can do until he got_sick. 3 And there_was a friend of Amnun named Hunadab child of Simyas a male brother/cousin of Dabid. And Hunadab was very brainy. 4 And he asked Amnun, “Why do I often_see you(sg) the child of the king grieving each morning? Please tell me of your(sg) problem?”

Ne migtabak si Amnun, “Naalihan a ki Tamar ne atebey te suled ku ne si Absalum.”

And Amnun answered, “I have love Tamar the sister of my sibling Absalum.”

5 Ne ingkahiyan sikandin ni Hunadab, “Hibat-hibat ka wey pareralu ka. Ne emun egleuy ka amey nu keykew, kahii nu sikandin, ‘Peendiniya nu ubag ka atebey ku ne si Tamar wey peuyana nu te egkakeen ne eg-andamen din kayi te tangkaan ku eyew egkakita ku, wey egpasungit a kandin.’ ” 6 Purisu miggibat si Amnun wey migpareralu sikandin.

5 And Hunadab said to him, “Stay_lying_down(sg) and put_on_sickness(sg). And when your(sg) father checks_on you(sg), tell him, ‘Please send_here(sg) my sister Tamar and have_(her)_bring(sg) something_to_eat and she will prepare it here in_front of me so that I'll see it, and I'll be fed by her.’ ” 6 Therefore Amnun lay_down and put_on_sickness(sg).

Te pegleuy te Hari kandin, ingkahiyan din sikandin, “Eghangyu a keykew ne peendiniya nu si Tamar ne atebey ku wey peyimuwa nu sikandin te pila-pila ne paan kayi te tangkaan ku su eyew egpasungit a kandin.”

When the king checked_on him, he told him, “I request you(sg) that you(sg) send_ Tamar my sister _here and get(sg)_ here _to_make some breads here in front of me so_that I can be fed by_her.”

7 Purisu impakahiyan e ni Dabid si Tamar diye te palasyu, “Hendiye ka te baley te maama nu ne si Amnun wey andami nu sikandin te egkakeen.” 8 Sikan naa ka miggendiyad si Tamar te baley te maama rin ne si Amnun wey neumaan din sikandin ne miggibat-hibat. Ne migkuwa si Tamar te harina wey inluyang din e seini wey inggimu rin e ne paan taheed te egpipitew si Amnun. Ne inggilutu din e seini. 9 Te nalutu e ka paan, inggeun din e seini puun te kale wey insendad din e ki Amnun piru ware sikandin migkeen. Ne impepalihawang e ni Amnun ka langun ne etew ne diye te tangkaan din. Purisu nanlihawang e ka me etew. 10 Ne ingkahiyan ni Amnun si Tamar, “Uyana nu kayi te sinabeng ka paan wey sungita a nikeykew.” Ne in-uyan e ni Tamar ka paan diye ki Amnun diye te sinabeng. 11 Piru te igparani rin e diye ki Amnun ka paan eyew egsungiten sikandin, inleheng e sikandin ni Amnun wey ingkahiyan, “Hendini ka atebey ku, hulid ka keddi.”

7 And Dabid had_ Tamar _told at the palace, “Go(sg) to the house of your(sg) older_brother Amnun and prepare(sg) him something_to_eat.” 8 And so Tamar went to the house of her older_brother Amnun who was lying_down. And Tamar took flour and she slurried it and she made bread while Amnun is watching. And she cooked this. 9 When the bread cooked already, she get_it_out from the pot and she served it to Amnun but he didn't eat. And Amnun caused all the people in_front of him to go_out. Therefore the people left. 10 And Amnun told Tamar, “Bring(sg) the bread here to my room and feed(sg) me.” And Tamar brought the bread to Amnun in the room. 11 But when she brought the bread to Amnun in_order to feed (it) him, she hugged by Amnun and said_(to_her), “Come_here(sg) my sister, lie(sg) with_me.”

12 Ne migtabak si Tamar, “Kena a nikeykew lehenga su kene seini ne eleg ne egkeyitabu kayi te Israil. Kene ka himu te sika ne dereeti ne himu. 13 Ke eglehengen a nikeykew, kene ku egkaantus ka hilew ku. Ne sikeykew, egkeyimu kad ne sabeka te me lalung ne etew kayi te Israil. Purisu, eghangyuen ku sikeykew ne inangen nu seini te Hari su migpalintutuu a ne kene ka nikandin egbalibaran te peg-asawa keddi.” 14 Piru ware sikandin pammineha ni Amnun wey neyimu rin iya ka igkeupii rin su manmanekal ma sikandin ki Tamar.

12 And Tamar answered, “Don't(sg) rape (LIT embrace) me because it's not correct to be_happened here in Israil. Don't(sg) do that very_evil act. 13 If I'm forced by_you(sg), I'm not able_to_endure my shame. And you(sg), you(sg) will_become one of the behaviorally_immoral_people here in Israil. Therefore, I request you(sg) that you(sg) tell this to the king because I believe that he won't refuse you(sg) in marrying me.” 14 But Amnun didn't listen and he indeed made what_he_want because he was stronger than Tamar.

15 Piru te neimpusan e seeye, sahuhune ne igkeepes e amana ni Amnun si Tamar wey migsubla pad ka pegkeepes din du te alig din kandin. Ne ingkahiyan ni Amnun si Tamar, “Awe ka kayi.”

15 But when that was_finished, suddenly Amnun greatly hate Tamar and his hate exceeded his desire for_her. And Tamar was_told by Amnun, “Get_out(sg) from here.”

16 Piru migtabak si Tamar, “Kena a nikeykew paawaa kayi su subla pad sika ne mareet du te pegleheng nu keddi.”

16 But Tamar answered, “Don't(sg) send_ me _away from_here because that would_be even more evil than your(sg) embracing me.”

Piru ware sikandin pammineha ni Amnun.17 Ne in-umew rin ka suluhuanen din wey ingkahiyan, “Ipalihawang nu seini se malitan wey pagguli nu ka gumawan ke egpakalihawang e sikandin.” 18 Purisu impalihawang e si Tamar te seeye ne suluhuanen wey impaggulan din e ka gumawan.

But Amnun didn't listen her.17 And he called his servant and told_(him/her), “Take_out(sg) this woman and lock(sg) the doorway when she's gone_out.” 18 Therefore Tamar was_taken_out by that servant and he/she locked the doorway.

Te seini ne timpu, migsaluub si Tamar te malayat wey mateles ne kumbale. Sika ka igsaluub te ware pad neyilabeti ne mengebay ne me anak te Hari dengan.19 Piru inggisi mule ni Tamar ka malayat wey mateles ne kumbale ne insaluub din wey intahuan din te abu ka ulu rin. Ne in-utuk din ka belad din wey miggipanew ne migpanaman migsinehew. 20 Ne mig-insaan si Tamar te maama rin ne si Absalum, “Inggilabetan ka te maama nu ne si Amnun? Kene nu re seini diralema atebey. Maama nu sikandin, purisu kene nu seini iwangal-wangal.” Ne diyad e mig-ugpe si Tamar te baley ni Absalum ne miglungku wey migmulmulengew.

At this time, Tamar was wearing a long and beautiful garment. That was what_was_worn by the single_girl who hasn't been_touched who_were children of the king long_ago.19 But Tamar torn the long and beautiful garment that_ she _was_wearing and she put ash on her head. And she put_ her hands _on_her_head and went_away crying intensely. 20 And Tamar was_asked by her older_brother Absalum, “Were you(sg) interfered_with by your(sg) big_brother Amnun? Don't take_ this _inside sister. He's your(sg) older_brother, therefore don't(sg) talk_openly of it.” And Tamar lived there at the house of Absalum grieving and lonely.

21 Te pegkanengnengi ni Dabid te neyitabu, nabelu amana sikandin. 22 Ne ware inlalag ni Absalum ki Amnun ne meupiya wey ke mareet piru indumutan din si Amnun tenged te pegpeyilew rin te atebey rin ne si Tamar.

21 When Dabid was_informed of what_had_happened, he was_ very _angry. 22 And Absalum said nothing to Amnun good or bad but he hated Amnun due to his shaming his sister Tamar.

Ka peggimatey ni Absalum ki Amnun

The revenging of Amnun by Absalum

23 Te peglihad te daruwa ne leg-un, impaalutan ni Absalum ka me karniru rin diye te Baal-Hasur ne marani te Ipraim. Ingginggat din ka langun ne lukes ne anak te Hari. 24 Ne miggendiye si Absalum te Hari wey migkahi, “Egpaalutan ku ka me karniru ku wey eghangyuen ku sikeykew wey ka me suluhuanen nu te pegtambung.”

23 When two years had passed, Absalum had_ his sheep _shorn there at Baal-Hasur near Ipraim. He invited all the children of the king. 24 And Absalum went to the king and said, “I'm having_ my sheep _to_be_shorn and I request you(sg) and your(sg) servants to attend this.”

25 Piru migtabak si Dabid, “Kena a egpekeendiye, anak. Kene egkaayun ne egmangendiye ki langun su egkahastuwan ka te dakel.” Piru migpamehes iya perem si Absalum kandin, piru ware iya miggendiye si Dabid. Impanalanginan din de si Absalum.

25 But Dabid answered, “I can't go, child. It's_ not _possible that we(incl) all go_there because you(sg) could_have_to_spend too much.” But Absalum persuaded him, but Dabid indeed didn't go_there. He just blessed Absalum.

26 Ne migkahi si Absalum, “Ke kene egkaayun, eghangyuen ku sikeykew ne iparuma nu keddi ka suled ku ne si Amnun.”

26 And Absalum said, “If it's_ not _possible, I request of you(sg) that you(sg) send_ Amnun _to_accompany me.”

Ne mig-insaan sikandin te Hari, “Mania te egparumeen nu sikandin?”27 Ne migpamehes iya si Absalum, sikan naa ka imparume e te Hari si Amnun wey ka langun ne anak din ne me lukes. 28 Ne impanpanayan ni Absalum ka me suluhuanen din, “Iipata niyu naa si Amnun ke egkewubug e wey ke egsuhu a kaniyu ne eggimatayan sikandin, himatayi niyud iya sikandin. Kene kew kaaldek su sikeddi ka migsuhu kaniyu. Pakannekal wey pakabbulut kew.” 29 Sikan naa ka inggimu e te me suluhuanen ni Absalum diye ki Amnun ka insuhu kandan. Ne migdagdahew nanguntud te me mula[fn] ran ka langun ne me anak te Hari, wey migmalungkesu e.

And he was_asked by the king, “Why would/should he go_with you(sg)?”27 And Absalum really persuaded, so_that Amun was_sent_to_accompany by the king and all his male children. 28 And Absalum instructed his servants, “Spy(pl) on Amnun if/when (he) gets_drunk and when I command you(pl) to_kill him, kill(pl) him indeed. Don't(pl) be_afraid because I (am) the (one who) commanded you(pl). Be_strong(pl) and be_fierce(pl).” 29 So then the servants of Absalum did to Amnun what he had told them. And all the children of the king mounted(pl) their mule[fn] hurriedly, and raced_off.

30 Taheed te diye pad sikandan te dalan peendiye te Hirusalim, due nakahuhud ki Dabid ne in-amin pangimatayi ni Absalum ka me anak din, wey warad iya sabeka kandan ne nasame. 31 Ne migsasindeg ka Hari wey inggisi din ka kumbale din wey miggibat diye te tane. Inggisi degma te me suluhuanen ne nanasindeg palingut kandin ka me kumbale dan. 32 Piru migkahi si Hunadab ne anak ni Simyas ne suled ni Dabid ne lukes, “Mahal ne Hari, kene ka suman-suman te impangimatayan ka langun ne me anak nu. Si Amnun de ka inggimatayan su tapey e seini planuwa ni Absalum puun pad te pegleheng ni Amnun ki Tamar. 33 Purisu kene ka palintutuu te guhuren ne impangimatayan ka langun ne me anak nu. Si Amnun de ka inggimatayan.”

30 While they were still on the road going to Hirusalim, there_was (someone who) storied to Dabid that Absalum had killed(pl) all of his children, and there_is_no_longer indeed one of_them remaining. 31 And the king stood and he tore his garment and he lay on the ground. The servants who were standing(pl) surrounding him also tore their garments. 32 But Hunadab the child of Simyas a male brother/cousin of Dabid said, “Honored king, don't(sg) think that all of your(sg) children were_killed(pl). It's just Amnun who has been_killed because this had been_previously planned by Absalum beginning from the raping (LIT embracing) of Tamar by Amnun. 33 Therefore don't(sg) believe the story that all of your(sg) children have_been_killed(pl). It was just Amnun who was_killed.”

34 Ne migpallahuy e si Absalum.

34 And Absalum had_fled.

Te pegpantew te talagtameng te palasyu, nakakita sikandin te masulug ne me etew ne egginguma ne egpuun te iglineb, wey diye namaye te kakiliran te bubungan. Ne miggendiyad ka talagbantey te Hari wey migkahi, “Due me etew ne nakita ku seeye te dalan te Hurunaim,[fn] seeye te kakiliran te bubungan.”35 Ne ingkahiyan ni Hunadab ka Hari, “Pitawa nu. Duen e ka me anak nu sumale te ingkahi ku ganna.” 36 Te nekeimpus e sikandin ka eglalag, nangingume e ka me anak te Hari wey migmanaman-taman sikandan naninehew. Ne migpanaman degma migsinehew ka Hari wey ka langun ne suluhuanen din.

On the looking_out by the guard of the palace, he saw many people approaching that from the east, and pass there to the beside of the mountain. And the guard went to the king and say, “There (were) people that I saw there on the road of Hurunaim,[fn] there beside the mountain.”35 And Hunadab told the king, “Look(sg). There are your(sg) children just_like I said earlier.” 36 When he finished speaking, the children of the king arrived(pl) and they cried(pl) intensely. And the king and all his officials also cried(pl) intensely.

37 [xr]Ne migpallahuy si Absalum wey miggendiye ki Talmai ne Hari te Gisur wey anak ni Amihud. Ne miglungku si Dabid te tagse aldew tenged te anak din ne si Amnun. 38 Ne diye pad mig-uugpe si Absalum te Gisur te tatelu ne leg-un. 39 Piru naalimengawan si Dabid ki Absalum te nataman e ka peglungku din tenged te pegpatey ni Amnun.

37 [xr]And Absalum fled and went to Talmai the king of Gishur and child of Amihud. And Dabid grieved every day for his child Amnun. 38 And Absalum lived there in Gishur for three years. 39 But Dabid missed Absalum when his mourning ended due to the death of Amnun.

Ka peg-uli ni Absalum diye te Hirusalim

The return of Absalum to Hirusalim

141 Nasabut ni Huwab ne anak ni Siruya ne naalimengawan e amana ka Hari ki Absalum. 2 Sikan naa ka migsuhu si Huwab te etew peendiye te Tikuwa eyew te peg-angey te matagseb ne malitan diye. Te pegginguma te malitan, ingkahiyan e sikandin ni Huwab, “Lilibat ka ne miglungku wey isaluub nu ka kumbale te eglungku. Kene ka pamaluhu te lana wey lilibat ka ne naluhey kad ne miglungku te minatey. 3 Ne hendiye ka te Hari wey ilalag nu kandin seini se ignangen ku keykew.” Ne impanulu e ni Huwab ka malitan ke nekey ka iglalag din te Hari.

141 Huwab the child of Siruya understood that the king greatly missed Absalum. 2 So then Huwab commanded a person to go_there to Tikuwa in_order for fetching a wise woman there. When the woman arrived, Huwab said to her, “Pretend(sg) to be mourning and dress(sg) in the clothing of (one) mourning. Don't(sg) rub with oil and pretend that you(sg) have_been_mourning for a dead_person for a long_time. 3 And go_there(sg) to the king and tell him this I'm going to tell you(sg).” Huwab taught the woman what_ she _should_say.

4 Te diyad e te tangkaan te Hari ka malitan ne matig-Tikuwa, mig-usengul sikandin diye te tane eyew te pegtahud kandin, wey migkahi, “Bulihi a ubag nikeykew, Hari!”

4 When the woman from_Tikuwa was there in front of the king, she bowed_low to the ground in_order for respecting him, and said, “Please help(sg) me, king!”

5 Ne mig-inse ka Hari kandin, “Nekey-a ka prublima nu?”

5 And the king asked her, “What is your(sg) reason_for_sadness?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Iyam e pad iya nabalu,6 wey due daruwa ne anak ku ne me lukes. Migpeehetey sikandan diye te kamet wey ware egpakapegnel kandan. Ne inlampesan te sabeka ka dangeb wey namatey e. 7 Ne kuntee, ahalen, egkuntereen ad te langun ne me karumaan ku. Migkahi sikandan, ‘Ibehey nu kanami ka miggimatey te suled din su eggimatayan ney degma sikandin. Kene sikandin ne eleg ne egpakakamuney te karatuan te amey rin.’ Te iling kayi ne paahi, eg-awaan a iya nikandan te langun ne nasame kayi te keddi wey egkawe e ka ngaran te iglukes ku kayi te kalibutan.”

And the woman answered, “I'm just became a widow,6 and I have two male children. They fought_each_other in the fields and no (one) was_able_to_prevent them. And one was struck by the other and died. 7 And now, I your(sg) servant, I've become_the_enemy of all my relatives. They say, ‘Give(sg) us(excl) the (one who) killed his sibling because we(excl) will_ also _kill him. He's not worthy to inherit the wealth of his father.’ In this way, I'll indeed have_ the remaining (one) _taken by them from me and the name of my husband will_be_removed here in the world.”

8 Ne ingkahiyan te Hari ka malitan, “Uli kad e. Iyan ad balahad ne eggusey te prublima nu.”

8 And the king said to the woman, “Return_home(sg) to your(sg) house. I'll take_charge to settle your(sg) problem.”

9 Ne ingkahiyan te malitan ne matig-Tikuwa ka Hari, “Mahal ne Hari, ke due egsendit keykew tenged te pegbulig nu keddi, sikeddi wey ka pamilya ku ka egpanabak wey kene ne sikeykew.”

9 And the woman from_Tikuwa said to the king, “Honored king, if there's (anyone who) blames your(sg) helping me, I and my family will_answer and not you(sg).”

10 Migkahi ka Hari, “Ke duen pad egpanlalag keykew te minsan nekey, dumaa nu sikandin kayi te keddi wey kene kud sikandin egtuhutan ne egsamuken ke pad nikandin.”

10 The king said, “If there's still (someone who) speaks_strongly to you(sg) about anything, accompany(sg) him/her here to me and he/she won't trouble you(sg) any_more.”

11 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Mahal ne Hari, saad ka ubag keddi pinaahi te Magbebaye ne Manama ne iyan ka Manama nu, ne kene nu egtuhutan ne duen pad egsuli te anak ku. Egkeupian a ne warad egpakalangesa.”

11 And she said, “Honored king, please promise(sg) me by_means of the Lord God who is your(sg) God, that you(sg) won't allow that there's still (someone who) will_revenge my child. I want that there's_no_more spilling_blood.”

Ne migkahi ka Hari, “Igsaad ku te manekal ne Manama ne kene iya egkareetan ka anak nu.[fn]”

And the king said, “I promise to the strong/living God that your(sg) child will_ not _be destroyed indeed.[fn]”

12 Ne mig-inse ka malitan, “Mahal ne Hari, egkaayun ne eg-inse e pad?”

12 And the woman asked, “Honored king, can I ask more?”

Ne migkahi ka Hari, “Ne uya, inse kad iya.”

And the king said, “Yes, ask(sg) on.”

13 Ne dutu, mig-inse e ka malitan, “Kene bu red ne mareet sika se eggimuwen nu diye te keet-etawan te Manama? Ka inlalag nu keddi migpeila sika ne nakasale ka su ware nu ma peulia kayi ka anak nu ne migpallahuy. 14 Egpatey ki langun—iling ki te weyig ne in-itis diye te tane ne kenad e egkalimud pad. Minsan ka Manama kene egbugtus te geyinawa te etew, ke kene, nasi sikandin egplanu ne egpekeuli diye te kandin ka etew ne nakariyu kandin. 15 Mahal ne Hari, miggendini a eyew te pegpakiglalag keykew meyitenged kayi su naaldek a te me etew. Migpakiglalag a keykew su kema ke egkabennalan ke red te ighangyu ku keykew. 16 Nakanengneng a ne egpammineg ka keddi, wey igpariyu a nikeykew puun te etew ne egdereet kanami te talaanak eyew egkaawe key te tane ne imbehey te Manama kanami. 17 [xr]Migsuman-suman a degma ne egpakaliwang keddi ka me lalag nu Hari, su egpekeiling ka te panalihan te Manama ne nakanengneng te meupiya wey mareet. Egdumaan ka perem te Magbebaye ne Manama ne iyan ka Manama nu.”

13 And then, the woman asked, “Is that not evil what you(sg) will do to the people of God? What you(sg) said to me shows that you(sg) sinned because you(sg) didn't allow_home your(sg) child who fled. 14 We(incl) all will_die—we are like water that is poured onto the ground that can't be gathered_up again. Even God won't cut_off the breath of a person, but rather, instead he plans that the people who become_distanced from_him return to him. 15 Honored king, I came_here in_order for speaking to you(sg) of this because I'm afraid of (the) people. I spoke_with you(sg) because maybe you(sg) will_ just _do what_ I _requested of_you(sg). 16 I know that you(sg) will_listen to me, and you(sg) will_distance me from the person that will destroy us(excl) mother_and_child so that we(excl) will_be_removed from land that God gave us(excl). 17 [xr]I also thought that your(sg) words could_comfort me king, because you(sg) are_like an angel of God that knows good and evil. May you(sg) be accompanied by the Lord God who is your(sg) God.”

18 Ne ingkahiyan te Hari ka malitan, “Due ig-inse ku keykew wey kene ke naa heeles.”

18 And the king said to the woman, “I'll ask you(sg) (something) and don't(sg) hide (it).”

Ne migkahi ka malitan, “Ne uya, Mahal ne Hari.”

And the woman said, “Yes, Honored King.”

19 Ne mig-inse e ka Hari, “Si Huwab ka migpanulu keykew kayi te langun?”

19 And the king asked, “Is Huwab taught you(sg) all of this?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Igpahunlibet ku te umul nu Mahal ne Hari, ne ware igpekeeles ne kamalehetan keykew. Uya, si Huwab ka mignangen keddi te eglalahen ku.20 Inggimu seini ni Huwab eyew egpekeg-uli e ka meupiya ne geyinawa niyu ki Absalum. Piru due katagseb nu Mahal ne Hari iling te katagseb te panalihan te Manama te pegnengneng te langun ne kayi te tane.”

And the woman answered, “I swear by your(sg) life Honored King, that no truth could be hiding (from) you(sg). Yes, I was_told by Huwab of what_ I _should_say.20 Your(sg) servant Huwab did this in_order to restore your(pl) good relationship with Absalum. Kena a egkeupian ne egpakakita kandin kayi te palasyu ku.” Purisu diye mig-ugpe si Absalum te baley rin wey ware migpakigkita te Hari.

Ka pegpeuliey ni Absalum wey ni Dabid

25 Te intiru ne Israil, ware lein ne indeyrey amana tenged te kateles din angin e ki Absalum. 25 In entire Israil, no other was praised due to his beauty except Absalum. He is looks good from his head_tip to his sole(s). 26 His hair was very thick and he had_ it _cut each year if/when it was long and heavy. And he weighed his hair and the weight of it on the scales of the king was about two kilograms. 27 And he had three male children and one female named Tamar and she was very gorgeous.

28 Ne mig-ugpe si Absalum diye te Hirusalim te daruwa ne leg-un ne ware migpakita te Hari. 29 Ne impaangey ni Absalum si Huwab eyew egpeendiyeen din te Hari piru ware miggendiye si Huwab kandin. Ne impaangey rin e man-e si Huwab piru ware ded iya man-e sikandin miggendiye te kandin. 30 Ne ingkahiyan ni Absalum ka me suluhuanen din, “Hendiyei niyu ka kamet ni Huwab wey silabi niyu ka sibada ne pinamula rin. Diye dapit seini te kamet ku.” Purisu insilaban e te me suluhuanen din ka pinamula ni Huwab.

28 Absalum lived there in Hirusalim for two years and didn't show to the king. 29 And Absalum sent_for Huwab in_order for sending him to the king but Huwab didn't go_there to_him. And he sent_for him again but he just indeed didn't go_there to_him. 30 And Absalum said to his servants, “Go_there(pl) to the field of Huwab and burn(pl) his barley plants. It's there beside my field.” Therefore the plants of Huwab was_burnt by his servants.

31 Seeye naa ka miggendiye si Huwab ki Absalum diye te baley rin wey mig-inse, “Mania te insilaban te me suluhuanen nu ka kamet ku?”

32 Ne migtabak si Absalum, “Tenged su ware ka miggendini te impaangey ku sikeykew. Egkeupian a ne eggendiye ka te Hari eyew te peg-inse kandin ke mania te impaangey a nikandin diye te Gisur. Meupiya pad ke migpalunggehaat e re diye. Purisu ipeendiya a nikeykew te Hari. Ke nakasale e ma, ne egkaayun ne eggimatayan a nikandin.”

It would have_been better if I had just remained there. Therefore have_ me _sent_there to the king. If I've sinned, it's ok if I'm killed by_him.”

Ka peggamba ni Absalum ki Dabid

151 Te neimpusan e seeye, nakakuwa si Absalum te me karwahi wey me kudde, wey lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me suluhuanen ne eggun-a egpallahuy kandin. 2 Te seeye ne timpu, imbatasan ni Absalum ne egselem-selem eg-enew wey diye egsesasindeg te ilis te dalan peendiye te gumawan te siyudad. Ke due etew ne eglihad ne due kasu ne igpewusey te Hari, eg-umawen din ka etew wey eg-insaan, “Hendei ka egpuun?” Ne egtabak ka etew, “Diya egpuun te inged ne in-ugpaan te sabeka te me tribu te Israil.” 3 Ne egkahiyan sikandin ni Absalum, “Due katarengan nu te kasu nu. Te ware naluhey, ingkeupii e te me etew si Absalum wey kenad ne si Dabid.

151 When that was_finished, Absalum had carts and horses, and fifty (50) servants who ran ahead of him. 2 At that time, it was the habit of Absalum to rise early and to stand_around there at the edge of the path going_towards the gateway of the city. If/When a person passed_by that had a case for the king to_rule_on, he will call the person and will_be_asked, “Where have you(sg) come from?” And the person would answer, “I'm from the place where one of the tribes of Israil lived.” 3 And he'd be told by Absalum, “You(sg) have a reason of your(sg) case. 7 Peglihad te hep-at ne leg-un, ingkahiyan ni Absalum si Dabid, “Tuhuti a nikeykew ne eggendiye te Hibrun eyew te pegtuman te saad ku te Magbebaye ne Manama. 8 Taheed te diye e pad te Gisur diye te Aram,[fn] migsesaad a te Magbebaye ne Manama ne emun ke egpaliberen a nikandin kayi te Hirusalim, egsimba a kandin diye te Hibrun.”

7 After four years passed, Absalum said to the king, “Permit(sg) me to go_there to Hibrun in_order for fulfilling my promise to the Lord God there. 8 While I was still there at Gisur in Aram,[fn] I promised to the Lord God that if I was returned by_him to Hirusalim, I would worship him there in Hibrun.”

9 Ne ingkahiyan sikandin te Hari, “Na, up-upiya ka te peggipanew nu!” Purisu miggendiyad si Absalum te Hibrun. 10 Piru miggeles-heles migsuhu si Absalum te me etew peendiye te langun ne tribu te Israil eyew egkahiyan ka me etew, “Te pegkarineg niyu te dahing te trumpita, panguleyi kew naa ne eggenendue, ‘Mighari e si Absalum wey diye sikandin mig-ugpe te Hibrun!’ ” 11 Ne migduma ki Absalum ka daruwa ne gatus (200) ne etew ne matig-Hirusalim ne impanginggat din piru ware kalintahaan dan te planu ni Absalum. 12 Ne taheed te migpanubad si Absalum te me mananap ne egtutungen, impaangey rin e si Ahitupil ne talagtambag ki Dabid puun diye te siyudad te Gilu ne ugpaan din. Te ware naluhey, migmasalig e ka me etew ne eglapig ki Absalum. Purisu migmalig-en pad iya ka planu rin ne eggamba ki Dabid.

9 And he was_told by the king, “Now_then, have a good travel (LIT take_care of your(sg) walking)!” Therefore Absalum went_there to Hibrun. 10 But Absalum commanded some people secretly going_on_to all the tribes of Israil so_as to tell the people, “When you(pl) hear the sound of a trumpet, shout(pl) going, ‘Absalum is kinging already and he live there in Hibrun!’ ” 11 Absalum accompanied two hundred (200) people from_Hirusalim that were invited(pl) by him but they weren't aware of the plan of Absalum. 12 And while Absalum sacrificed an animals by burning, he sent_for Ahitupil the advisor of Dabid from the city of Gilu his residence. Before long, the people aligning with Absalum increased. Therefore his plan to overpower against Dabid strengthened more.

13 Due migginguma ne insuhu ne egpahuhuren ki Dabid, “Diyad e miglapig ki Absalum ka me matig-Israil.”

24 And Abiyatar and Saduk the sacrificers were also there accompanied by all the Libitas who were carrying_on_poles the Container of the Agreement of God.
