10 Piru migtabak ka Hari, “Sikaniyu se me anak ni Siruya, nekey bes ka labet niyu? Ke insuhu sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egdilusen a, hentew e naa degma ka egbalabag kandin?” 11 Ne ingkahiyan ni Dabid si Abisay wey ka langun ne suluhuanen din, “Ke migpakannekal ma ka anak ku mismu te peggimatey keddi, iyan naan pa iya ka seini se etew ne kabuhalan ni Binhamin? Balahara niyu re due sikandin ka egpandilus su insuhu sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama. 12 Kema ke egkakita te Magbebaye ne Manama ka kalasayan ku wey egsulian din te meupiya ka pegdilus din keddi kuntee ne aldew.” 13 Purisu migpabulus e si Dabid wey ka langun ne etew rin te peggipanew taheed te diye migbaye si Simii te bubungan ne egkatalipag dan. Ne migpabulus sikandin ka egdilus ki Dabid te sasangan sikandin ne eggipanew. Ne impandegpak din sikandin te batu wey insabulakan te alinepung. 14 Ne migginguma si Dabid wey ka langun ne etew ne migduma kandin diye te Weyig ne Hurdan[fn] ne nabeley-beley. Ne nangimeley e sikandan diye.

10 But the king answered, “You(pl) sons of Siruya, what's your(sg) involvement? If the Lord God commanded him to cursed me, who am I also to prevent him?” 11 And Dabid said to Abisay and all his servants, “If my own child strives to kill me, how much more this person who is a descendant of Binhamin? Just ignore(pl) him cursing(pl) because he was commanded by the Lord God. 12 What if the Lord God has seen my difficulty and he avenges his cursing of me this day with good.” 13 Therefore Dabid and all his people continued traveling/walking while Simii went_via the hill opposite them. And he continued to curse Dabid while he walked. And he threw stones and threw_handfuls of dust. 14 And Dabid and all the people who accompanied him arrived at the River Hurdan[fn] tired(pl). And they rested there.

Ka tambag ni Husay wey ni Ahitupil

The advice of Husay and of Ahitupil

15 Te seeye ne timpu, miggendiye si Absalum te Hirusalim ne indumaan ni Ahitupil wey te langun ne matig-Israil. 16 Te nekeume e si Husay ne Arkihanen ne alukuy ni Dabid, sahuhune ne miggendiye sikandin ki Absalum wey migkahi, “Egkeuyag ka Hari! Egkeuyag ka Hari!”

15 At that time, Absalum went to Hirusalim accompanied by Ahitupil and all the (ones) from_Israil. 16 When Husay the Arkihanon the friend of Dabid arrived, immediately he went to Absalum and said, “May the king live! May the king live!”

17 Ne mig-insaan ni Absalum si Husay, “Seini naa ka pegpapitew nu te geyinawa te alukuy nu ne si Dabid? Mania te ware ka migduma kandin?”

17 And Absalum questioned Husay, “Is this how you(sg) show love to your(sg) friend Dabid? Why didn't you(sg) accompany him?”

18 Migtabak si Husay, “Kene ku sika egkeyimu. Diya a eglapig te etew ne in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama, te me etew ne kayi kuntee, wey te langun ne etew te Israil. Ne egpalunggehaat a duma kandin. 19 Timul pad due, hentew bes iya ka egpamakayen ku, ke kene sikeykew man de iya se anak te ahalen ku ne si Dabid? Egpamakey a degma keykew, iling te pegpamakey ku te amey nu.”

18 Husay answered, “I wouldn't do that. I align there with the person chosen by the Lord God, by the people who (are) here now, and by all the people of Israil. And I will_remain with him. 19 Adding to that, who will_ I _serve, but_rather only you(sg) the child of my master Dabid? I will_ also _serve you(sg), just how I served your(sg) father.”

20 Ne ingkahiyan ni Absalum si Ahitupil, “Ne la, tambag ka ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen ta.”

20 And Absalum said to Ahitupil, “Well then, advise(sg) what's the correct (thing) for us(incl) to do.”

21 Ne migtabak si Ahitupil, “Panguliri nu ka me duwey te amey nu ne inggaat din eyew te pegtanggu te palasyu. Ne egkarineg te langun ne matig-Israil ne impeyibelu nu amana ka amey nu. Ne puun due, egkanas-nasian pad ne egkabagget ka me etew ne eglapig keykew.” 22 [xr]Purisu inggimuwan dan si Absalum te balungbalung diye te atep,[fn] wey diye din hilabeti ka me duwey te amey rin ne egkakita-kita re due te me etew.

21 And Ahitupil answered, “Play_sexually(sg) with the junior_wives of your(sg) father that he left_behind in_order for looking_after the palace. And all from_Israil will_hear that you(sg) caused_ your(sg) father _to_be_angry at_you(sg) very_much. And from that, the people will_be_encouraged more to favor with_you(sg).” 22 [xr]Therefore they made Absalum a tent there on the roof,[fn] and there he meddle/touch/commit_adultery with the junior_wives of his father that will_be_seen by the people.

23 Te seeye ne timpu, in-ikul iya ni Absalum ka me tambag ni Ahitupil, iling te inggimu ni Dabid su in-isip dan ne egpuun te Manama ka tambag ni Ahitupil.

23 At that time, the advice(s) of Ahitupil was followed by Absalum, like what Dabid did because they consider that the advice of Ahitupil came from God.

Ka pegsupak ni Husay te tambag ni Ahitupil

The disobeying by Husay of the advice of Ahitupil

171 Ne ingkahiyan ni Ahitupil si Absalum, “Paalama a nikeykew te sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) ne etew ne egpatalukunen ki Dabid te seini ne karusileman. 2 Eglusuran ku sikandin taheed te nabeley sikandin wey migmahuye se geyinawa. Egginaalreken ku sikandin wey egmakapallahuy iya ka langun ne me duma rin. Ne si Dabid de ka eggimatayan ku. 3 Ne igpalibed ku diye te keykew ka langun ne me etew rin iling te asawa ne miglibed diye te iglukes din. Sabeka re ne etew ka igkeupii nu te eggimatey, wey egmalinawen e ka langun ne etew.” 4 Ne nakapahale ka tambag ni Ahitupil ki Absalum wey te langun ne igbuyag te Israil.

171 And Ahitupil said to Absalum, “Let(sg)_ me _choose twelve thousand (12,000) people in_order for pursuing Dabid this night. 2 I'll attack him while he's tired and weak breath. I will_frighten him and all of his companions will_flee(pl). And it's just Dabid that I'll kill. 3 And I'll cause_all his people_return to you(sg) like the wife that return to her husband. Only one person you(sg) want to kill, and all the people will_be_peaceful.” 4 And the advice of Ahitupil to Absalum and all the elders of Israil gave_joy.

5 Piru migkahi si Absalum, “Umawa nu degma si Husay, ka Arkihanen su eyew egpakarineg ki ke nekey ka igkalalag din.” 6 Te pegginguma ni Husay, impanugtulan e sikandin ni Absalum te intambag ni Ahitupil. Ne migkahi si Absalum, “Eggimuwen te naa ka intambag din? Ne emun ke kene, nekey naa ka igkalalag nu?”

5 But Absalum said, “Call(sg) Husay, the Arkihanon also so_that we(incl) can_hear what he will_say.” 6 On the arrival of Husay, he was_told by Absalum what_ Ahitupil _had_advised. And Absalum said, “Shall we(incl) do what_ he _advised? And if not, what do_ you(sg) _have_to_say?”

7 Ne ingkahiyan ni Husay si Absalum, “Te seini ne timpu, kene ne meupiya ka tambag ni Ahitupil. 8 Nakanengneng ka te bahani ka amey nu wey ka me etew rin, wey nabelu-belu sikandan iling te mahintalunan ne usu ne natakawan te me anak. Ne kene ne sikan de, su ka amey nu mangngateu ne bahani wey kene iya sikandin eglipereng duma te me etew. 9 Minsan kuntee, diye sikandin te sabeka ne sulung wey ke diye naa te lein ne inged. Ke egkewun-aan ka nikandin te eglusud wey due egpatey te me etew nu, egkahi ka minsan hentew ne egpakarineg kayi te natalu e ka me etew nu. 10 Ne minsan pad ka bubuluti ne sundalu ne egpekeiling te liyun ne ware liyas, eggingumaan te liyas su nakanengneng ka intiru ne Israil te bahani ka amey nu wey mabbulut ka me etew rin. 11 Purisu seini ka igpakatambag ku keykew. Sabekaa nu ka langun ne matig-Israil puun te Dan peendiye te Birsiba ne egpekeiling kasulug te pantad diye te ilis te dahat wey sikeykew mismu ka egpangulu kandan diye te bunuanan. 12 Kene sikandin egpekeeles kanta. Ne iling te demmug ne egkeulug minsan hendei, eglusuran ta degma sikandin minsan hendei ta sikandin egkakita. Ne egkapatey iya sikandin wey ka langun ne etew rin. 13 Ke egpallahuy sikandin diye te sabeka ne siyudad, egguhusen[fn] ta ka sika ne siyudad taman te warad egkasame ne batu minsan sabeka.”

7 And Husay said to Absalum, “This time, the advice of Ahitupil isn't good. 8 You(sg) are aware that you(sg) father and his people are warrior(s), and he's very_angry like a wild bear that's been_robbed_of (its) children. And not just that, because your(sg) father is a wise warrior and indeed he won't sleep together_with the people. 9 Even now, he's there in a (LIT one) cave or there in a different place. If you(sg) are attacked first by_him and (if) some of your(sg) people are_killed(pl), anybody who hears this will_say your(sg) people have_been_defeated. 10 And even the extremely_brave soldier that's like a lion without fear, will_be_overcome with cowardness because entire Israil knows that your(sg) father is a warrior and his people are very_fierce. 11 Therefore this_is_what_ I _can advise you(sg). Unite all the (ones) from_Israil from Dan to Birsiba like the large_number of sand there at the edge of the sea and you(sg) yourself (are) the (one who) leads them in fighting. 12 He will_ not _be_able_to_hide us(incl). And like the dew that fall wherever, we(incl) will_ also _attack him wherever we(incl) find him. And he and all his people will_ indeed _be_killed. 13 If he runs to a (LIT one) city, we(incl) will_demolish[fn] that city until there's_no remaining stone not even one.”

14 Ne migkahi si Absalum wey ka langun ne matig-Israil, “Meupiya ka tambag ni Husay ne Arkihanen du te tambag ni Ahitupil.” Pegbuut te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kene eg-ikulen ni Absalum ka meupiya ne tambag ni Ahitupil su eyew egpakasalerep sikandin te karereetan.

14 And Absalum and all the (ones) from_Israil said, “The advice of Husay the Arkihanon is better than the advice of Ahitupil.” It was the will of the Lord God that Absalum didn't follow the good advice of Ahitupil so_that he would overtaken by destruction.

Ka pegpaney-paney ki Dabid ne egpepallahuyen

The instructing Dabid to flee

15 Ne innangenan ni Husay ka me talagpanubad ne ensi Saduk wey Abiyatar meyitenged te tambag ni Ahitupil ki Absalum wey te me matig-Israil, wey innangenan din degma sikandan te tambag din. 16 Ne innangenan din sikandan, “Dagdahew kew suhu te etew wey pakahii niyu si Dabid te kenad sikandan egpeyireheen diye te weyig ne lapasanan peendiye te disirtu. Palapasa nud sikandan paragdahawa, su ke kene, egkareetan iya ka Hari wey ka langun ne etew ne duma rin.”

15 And Husay told the sacrificers Saduk and Abiyatar about Ahitupil's advice to Absalum and to the (ones) from_Israil, and he also told them his advice. 16 And he told them, “Immediately(pl) command a person and have_ Dabid _told that they shouldn't overnight there at the river crossing going to the desert. Get(sg)_ them _to_cross quickly, because if not, the king and all the people accompanying him will_be_destroyed.”

17 Te seini ne timpu, diye migtetahad te sebseb te Inruhil si Diyunatan wey si Ahimaas su keilangan ne kene sikandan egkakita ne egseled diye te siyudad. Ne due suluhuanen ne malitan ne talagnangen engki Diyunatan wey ki Ahimaas ke nekey e ka neyitabu wey sikandan e degma ka egnangen ki Dabid. 18 Piru due sabeka ne kanakan ne nakakita kandan wey impanugtulan din e si Absalum meyitenged dutu. Sikan naa ka migdagdahew e mig-awe si Diyunatan wey si Ahimaas wey miggendiyad e te baley te sabeka ne etew diye te Bahurim. Ka seini ne etew due belun diye te lama rin wey migpamaneug e sikandan dutu eyew eggeles. 19 Insupaan te asawa te etew ka be-be te belun wey indampilan din e te trigu ka insupe din kayi. Ne ware minsan hentew ne nakanengneng ne miggeles sikandan dutu. 20 Te pegginguma te me etew ni Absalum diye te baley, in-insaan dan e ka malitan, “Hendei naan e si Ahimaas wey si Diyunatan?”

17 At this time, Diyunatan and Ahimaas lived at the spring of Inruhil because it was necessary that they weren't seen entering the city. And there_was a female servant informer to Diyunatan and Ahimaas what happened and they all were the (ones who) told Dabid. 18 But there_was one young_man who saw them and he told Absalum concerning this. So then Diyunatan and Ahimaas quickly left and went to the house of one person there in/at Bahurin. This person had a well in his yard and they climbed_down this in_order to hide. 19 A woman covered the mouth of the well and put_ wheat _to_dry on what_ she _covered_ it _with. And no (one) knew that they were hiding there. 20 At the arrival of the people of Absalum there at the house, they asked the woman, “Where are Ahimaas and Diyunatan?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Miglapas e sikandan te weyig.”

And the woman answered, “They crossed the river/water.”

Ne impamitew ran e si Ahimaas wey si Diyunatan piru ware dan sikandan nakita. Sikan naa ka miglibed e sikandan diye te Hirusalim.

And they searched_for Ahimaas and Diyunatan but they didn't find them. So then they returned to Hirusalim.

21 Te warad e ka me etew ne egpamitew kandan, mig-awe e sikandan puun te belun wey miggipanew e sikandan ka egnangen ki Hari Dabid meyitenged te tambag ni Ahitupil. Ne ingkahiyan dan e ensi Dabid, “Apas kew lapas te weyig.” 22 Ne miglapas e te Weyig ne Hurdan ensi Dabid wey ka langun ne etew ne migduma kandin. Te egkaliwaswas e, nakalapas e sikandan langun.

21 When the people where were searching for them were gone, they exited from the well and they went to inform King Dabid concerning the advice of Ahitupil. And they said to Dabid_and_companions, “Hurry(pl) to cross the river.” 22 And Dabid and all the people who accompanied him crossed the Jordan River. By dawn, they all had crossed.

23 Te pegkanengnengi ni Ahitupil te ware ikula ka tambag din, insakangan din e ka asnu rin wey mig-uli e sikandin diye te lungsud din. Ne migpanaha-taha sikandin te pamilya rin wey mig-ehet-ehet e sikandin ne migbibitin. Sikan naa ka migpatey e sikandin wey diye sikandin ilebeng te inlebengan te amey rin.

23 When Ahitupil realized that his advice was_ not _followed, he saddled his donkey and he returned_home to his town. And he farewelled his family and he committed_suicide by hanging (himself). That then was his death and he was_buried there at the grave of his father.

24 Ne nekeume e si Dabid diye te Mahanaim, taheed te eglapas pad si Absalum te Hurdan duma te langun ne sundalu te Israil. 25 In-alam ni Absalum si Amasa ne pangulu te me sundalu subal ki Huwab. Si Amasa anak ni Itra ne sabeka ne Ismailita.[fn] Si Abigil ka iney rin ne anak ni Nahas, wey atebey ni Siruya. Ne si Siruya, iney ni Huwab. 26 Ne migkekampu ka me matig-Israil wey si Absalum diye te Gilyad.

24 And Dabid went to Mahanaim, while Absalum still cross the Hurdan along_with all the people of Israil. 25 Absalum chose Amasa as leader of the soldiers replacing Huwab. Amasa was the male child of Itra a (LIT one) Ismailita.[fn] Abigil the child of Nahas, and sister of Siruya was his mother. And Siruya, was the mother of Huwab. 26 And the (ones) from_Israil and Absalum camped there at the land of Gilyad.

27 Te pegginguma ni Dabid diye te Mahanaim, insinug-ung e sikandin ni Subi ne anak ne lukes ni Nahas ne egpuun te Raba diye te Amun, wey ni Makir ne anak ne lukes ni Amiyil ne egpuun te Lu-Dibar, wey ni Barsilay ne egpuun te Ruhilim diye te Gilyad. 28 Ne nanguyan sikandan te me hibatanan, me pelenggana, me kendiru, trigu, sibada, harina, sinandag ne keenen, me gulay, 29 teneb, me karniru, wey te egkakeen ne inggimu puun te gatas te baka, wey puun te gatas te karniru. Imbehey ran seini ki Dabid wey te me etew rin su nakanengneng sikandan ne miggutasan sikandan, nabbeley, wey namadmaraan te peggipanew ran puun te disirtu.

27 At the arrival of Dabid at Mahanaim, he met Subi the male child of Nahas coming_from Raba in Amun, and Makir the male child of Amiyil coming_from Lu-Dibar, and Barsilay coming from Ruhilim in Gilyad. 28 And they brought beds, basins, pots, wheat, barley, flour, roasted food, vegetables, 29 honey, sheep, and food that's made from the milk of cow, and from the milk of sheep. They gave this to Dabid and his people because they knew that they were_hungry, tired, and thirsty from the traveling from the desert.

Ka pegkapatey ni Absalum

The killing of Absalum

181 Ne inlibulung ni Dabid ka me etew ne migduma kandin. Ne imbaad-baad din sikandan te tigsenge-libu (1,000) wey tigmahatus (100). Ne mig-alam sikandin te egpangulu te tagse punduk. 2 Ne impeyipanew ni Dabid sikandan te tatelu ne punduk. Ne si Huwab ka migpangulu te sabeka ne punduk, si Abisay ne suled ni Huwab ka migpangulu te igkarangeb ne punduk, wey si Itay ne Hitihanen ka migpangulu te igkatelu ne punduk. Ne migkahi si Hari Dabid, “Egduma a iya kaniyu te egbubunu.”

181 And Dabid gathered the people who accompanied him. And then he divided them into thousands (1,000) and hundreds (100). And he chose (people) to lead each group. 2 And Dabid sent_them_out in three groups. And Huwab led one group, Abisay the sibling/cousin of Huwab led the second group, and Itay the Hitihanon led the third group. And King Dabid said, “I will_ indeed _accompany you(pl) in fighting.”

3 Piru ingkahiyan sikandin te me etew, “Keilangan ne kene ke re egduma kanami, su ke egpakapallahuy key, egbalaharen key re nikandan, minsan pad ke katenge kanami ka egpatey. Piru para kanami, egpekeiling ka mule te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne sundalu, purisu meupiya pad ke egpalunggehaat ke re diye te siyudad wey peuyani key re te igkabulig nu kanami.”

3 But he was_told by the people, “It's_necessary that you(sg) just don't accompany us(excl), because if we(excl) flee, we(excl) will_be_ignored by_them, even if half of us(excl) are killed. But for us(excl), you(sg) on_the_contrary are_like ten thousand (10,000) soldiers, therefore it would_be better if you(sg) just remain there in the city and just send us(excl) what_ you(sg) _can_help us(excl).”

4 Ne migtabak ka Hari, “Eggimuwen ku ka minsan nekey ne insuman-suman niyu ne meupiya.” Ne migsasindeg ka Hari diye te kakiliran te gumawan te siyudad taheed te migmanlihawang te tigsenge-libu (1,000) wey tigmahatus (100) ka langun ne sundalu. 5 Ne impanagtahaan te Hari si Huwab, si Abisay, wey si Itay te migkahi, “Kene niyu menuwa si Absalum tenged keddiey.” Ne nakarineg ka langun ne sundalu te impanaha-taha te Hari te me kumandir meyitenged ki Absalum.

4 And the king answered, “I will_do whatever you(pl) think is good.” And the king stood at the side of the doorway of the city while all the soldiers exited(pl) in groups of thousand (1,000) and one hundred (100). 5 And the king instructed Huwab, Abisay, and Itay saying, “Don't harm Absalum on my_behalf.” And all the soldiers heard the instruction of the king to commanders concerning Absalum.

6 Purisu migpeendiyad te bunuanan ka me sundalu ni Dabid eyew te pegpakigbunu te me matig-Israil. Ne diye sikandan migpabunbunuey te Puwalas te Ipraim. 7 Ne natalu te me etew ni Dabid ka me matig-Israil diye. Ne susuluhi ka migpatey te seeye ne aldew—daruwa ne pulu ne libu (20,000) ne etew. 8 Ne nekeempet te intiru ne tane ka gira wey masulug ka migpatey ne migsahap diye te puwalas du te migpatey te gira.

6 Therefore the soldiers of Dabid went to the fighting_place in_order for fighting the (ones) from_Israil. And they fought there in the Forest of Ipraim. 7 And the (ones) from_Israil were_defeated by the people of Dabid. And (there) were extremely_many who died(pl) on that day—twenty thousand (20,000) people. 8 And the fighting covered the entire ground and many_more died(pl) there in the forest than died in war.

9 Ne sahuhune ne nasinug-ung ni Absalum ka me etew ni Dabid. Te seeye ne timpu, mig-untud sikandin te mula.[fn] Diye migbaye ka kudde te diralem te dakel ne uk ne kayu wey migsanggat ka ulu rin te me sugpang kayi. Ne migpabulus e migpallahuy ka kudde taheed te nahaat si Absalum ne nabitin. 10 Ne due nakakita ki Absalum wey ingkahiyan din e si Huwab, “Nakita ku si Absalum ne nabitin diye te kayu ne uk.”

9 And suddenly Absalum met the people of Dabid. At that time, he was_riding mula.[fn] The horse passed under the large uk tree and his head got caught in a branch. And the horse continued to run while Absalum remained hanging. 10 And there_was (someone who) saw Absalum and he told Huwab, “I saw Absalum hanging there to the uk tree.”

11 Ne ingkahiyan ni Huwab seeye se etew ne migpanugtul kandin, “Nekey? Nakita nu sikandin? Mania te ware nu sikandin himatayi? Egbehayan ku perem sikeykew te sapulu ne seleppi ne pelata wey sabeka ne sinturun te bahani.”

11 And Huwab told that person who informed him, “What? You(sg) saw him? Why didn't you(sg) kill him? I would have given you(sg) ten silver coins and one warrior's belt.”

12 Piru ingkahiyan si Huwab te seeye se etew, “Minsan ke egbehayan e pad nikeykew te senge-libu (1,000) ne timman ne seleppi ne pelata, kene ku eggimatayan ka anak te Hari. Nakarineg key te pegpanaha-taha te Hari keykew, ki Abisay, wey ki Itay ne keilangan ne kene egmenuwen si Absalum tenged kandin. 13 Piru ke eg-akalan ku ka Hari pinaahi te peggimatey te anak din wey ke egkanengnengan din seini, kena a iya nikeykew egpangabangan.”

12 But that person told Huwab, “Even if I was_given one thousand (1,000) pieces of silver coin by_you(sg), I wouldn't kill the child of the king. We(excl) heard the instructing of the king to_you(sg), to Abisay, and to Itay that it's_necessary that Absalum is not harmed for him. 13 But if I will_betray the king by_means of killing his child and if he became informed of this, I would not indeed help by_you(sg).”

14 Ne migkahi si Huwab, “Ware karuan ke egpakiglalag e pad keykew meyitenged due.” Ne migkuwa sikandin te tatelu ne kelaab wey impilak din e diye te pusung si Absalum taheed te manekal pad sikandin ne nabitin diye te uk ne kayu. 15 Ne inlingutan pad iya man-e si Absalum te sapulu ne kanakan ne talag-uyan te me panganiban ni Huwab wey inggimatayan dan e sikandin.

14 And Huwab said, “There's_no point if I speak further with you(sg) concerning this.” And he took three spears and he stabbed the heart of Absalum while he was still strong/alive hanging there to the uk tree. 15 And then Absalum was_surrounded again by ten young_men who were carriers of the weapons of Huwab and they killed him.

16 Ne imparahing e ni Huwab ka trumpita eyew te pegpasanggel te me etew rin te pegtalukun te me sundalu te Israil. 17 Ne ingkuwa ran e ka lawa ni Absalum wey in-ulug dan e diye te maralem ne lungag diye te puwalas wey intambuan dan e te me batu. Taheed te egkalihet pad sikandan ka egtetambu, namallahuy e ka langun ne matig-Israil diye te me ugpaan dan.

Ka katammanan ne lalag ni Dabid

The final speech of Dabid

231 Si Dabid ne anak ni Hisi ka etew ne imbantug te Manama. In-alam sikandin ne Hari te Manama ni Hakub, wey sikandin ka talaggimu te meupiya ne me ulahingen diye te Israil. Seini ka katammanan ne me lalag ni Dabid:

231 Dabid the child of Hisi was the person made_famous by God. He was_chosen as king by the God of Hakub, and he was the maker of good songs in Israil. These (are) the final words of Dabid:

2 “Ka Panisingan te Manama migpakiglalag pinaahi keddi

wey impanulu a nikandin ke nekey ka eglalahen ku.

and he/she taught me what_ I (should) _say.

‘Ke egmandu ka sabeka ne etew duma te katareng wey kaaldek te Manama,

‘If/when one person rules along_with righteousness and fear of God,

4 eglayag sikandin iling te pegsile te aldew,

4 he will_shine like the rising sun,

iling te maselem ne ware gapun,

like the morning without cloud,

wey iling te uran ne egpakapatubu te me hilamunen.’

and like the rain that can_cause_to_sprout the grasses.’

5 “Ne iling due ka pegpanalangin te Manama te pamilya ku tenged su miggimu sikandin te kasabutan ne ware egtamanan duma keddi.

5 “And like that the blessing of my family by God because he made an agreement that without ending with me.

Ka sika ne kasabutan, naay-ayaran te eggimu wey kene egkabalbalawan.

That agreement, was_made_carefully and won't be_changed.

Ne egpangabangan a nikandin layun

And I am always helped by_him

wey igbehey rin ka langun ne eg-im-imanen ku.

and he will_give all that I hoped_for.

6 Piru ka ware karuan ne me etew, egpekeiling te me duhi ne igdegpak de,

6 But the worthless people, are_like thorns that will_be_just thrown_away,

because these can't be held.

Ka me bahani ni Dabid

The warriors of Dabid

(1 Kru 11:10‑41)

(1 Chr 11:10‑41)

8 Seini ka me ngaran te me bahani ni Dabid: si Husi-Basibit ne sabeka ne Takunihanen ne pangulu te Tatelu ne Bahani. Nakapatey sikandin te walu ne gatus (800) ne me etew pinaahi te kalawit te sabeka re ne gira.

8 These (are) the names of the warriors of Dabid: Husi-Basibit a Takunihanon a leader of the Three Warriors. He killed eight hundred (800) people by_means of a spear in just one war.

9 Ka ikarangeb kandin si Ilyasar ne anak ni Dudu ne kabuhalan ni Ahu. Sabeka sikandin te tatelu ne me bahani ne migduma ki Dabid te pegganggat te me Pilistihanen ne miglibulung eyew te pegbubunu. Ne nenakapallahuy ka me sundalu ne me matig-Israil, 10 piru migpalunggehaat mule sikandin wey migpakig-ehet te me Pilistihanen taman te napu-pu e ka belad din wey hendue te kene din e egkalekaan ka kampilan din. Ne impepanalu sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama wey nahule ka me kuntere te seeye ne aldew. Ne migmanlibed ka namallahuy ne me sundalu ne matig-Israil eyew te pegpanguwa naan de te me kasangkapan te me minatey.

9 The next to him is Ilyasar the child of Dudu the descendant from_Ahu. He was one of the three warriors who accompanied Dabid in challenging the Pilistihanons who were gathered for fighting. And those soldiers from_Israil fled, 10 but he on_the_contrary remained_behind and fought the Pilistihanons until (his) hand/arm(s) was worn_out and it_was_like that he couldn't release his sword. And he was_given_victory by the Lord God and the enemies were exterminated on that day. And the (ones) from_Israil soldiers who fled(pl) returned(pl) just in_order for merely taking(pl) the possessions of the corpses.

11 Ne ka igkatelu, si Sama ne anak ni Agi ne matig-Harar. Sabeka ne timpu, miglibulung ka me Pilistihanen diye te Lihi wey inlusuran dan ka me matig-Israil diye te due kamet ne neempet te bengag. Ne namallahuy ka me matig-Israil eyew te pegpanalliya te me Pilistihanen. 12 Piru migpalunggehaat mule si Sama diye te taliware te kamet. Ne migpakig-ehet sikandin te me Pilistihanen wey neneyimatayan din sikandan. Ne impepanalu sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama te dakel ne kapanaluwan te sika ne aldew.

11 And the third, was Sama the child of Agi from_Harar. One time, the Pilistihanons gathered there at Lihi and they attacked the (ones) from_Israil there in the field full with lentil. And the (ones) from_Israil fled in_order to escape of the Pilistihanons. 12 But Sama just remained_behind there in the middle of the field. And he fought the Pilistihanons and he killed(pl) them. And he was_given_victory by the Lord God with a great victory on that day.

13 Te timpu te tinggaani, miggendiye ki Dabid diye te sulung te Adulam ka tatelu te seeye se tatelu ne pulu (30) ne me pangulu, taheed te diyad migkekampu te napu diye te Ripaim ka punduk te me Pilistihanen. 14 Te sika ne timpu, diye si Dabid te malig-en ne inged, wey diyad te Bitlihim ka kampu te me Pilistihanen. 15 Ne nammaraan si Dabid wey migkahi, “Meupiya ubag perem ke due sabeka ne egsakug te weyig diye te belun ne marani te gumawan te Bitlihim!” 16 Sikan naa ka miggeles-heles miggendiye ka tatelu ne bahani te kampu te Pilistihanen wey migsakug te weyig diye te belun ne marani te gumawan te Bitlihim. Ne in-uyan dan e ka weyig diye ki Dabid piru ware din seini inuma. Nasi din seini itisa diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama isip halad. 17 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Magbebaye ne Manama, kene ku iya seini eg-inumen. Su ke eg-inumen ku seini, iling de te in-inum ku ka langesa te me etew ne ware mig-ulung-ulung ne migsakug te weyig.” Purisu ware din seeye inuma.

13 At the time of harvest, the three of those thirty (30) leaders went to Dabid there in the cave at Adulam, while the group of the Pilistihanons encamped in the plain there at Ripaim. 14 At that time, Dabid was there in a strong/secure place/village, and the camp of the Pilistihanons was at Bitlihim. 15 And Dabid was thirsty and said, “It would be good [hopefully] [politely] if there_was (someone who would) get_ me water _to_drink from the well near the entrance to Bitlihim!” 16 So then the three warriors secretly went_there to the camp of the Pilistihanons and drew water there from the well near the entrance of Bitlihim. And they took the water to Dabid but he didn't drink it. Instead he tipped_ it _out there in front of the Lord God as an offering. 17 And he said, “Lord God, I won't indeed drink this. Because if I'll drink this, it's like that I drank the blood of people who drawing water without hesitation.” Therefore he didn't drink it.

Seeye ka inggimu te tatelu ne bahani.

That was what_ the three warrior people _did.

18 Ne si Abisay ne suled ni Huwab ne anak ni Siruya, iyan pangulu te seeye se tatelu ne pulu (30). Nekeyimatey sikandin te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne etew ne iyan din inggamit ka kalawit din. Sikan naa ka migmabantug degma sikandin iling te tatelu ne me bahani. 19 Sikandin ka amana ne talahuren te tatelu ne pulu (30) wey neyimu ne pangulu ran, piru ware sikandin nakalagkes te seeye se tatelu ne mabbulut.

18 And Abisay the brother of Huwab and child/son of Siruya, the leader of those thirty (30). He killed three hundred (300) men and what he used was his spear. That's why he also was_famous like the three warriors. 19 He (was) the very respected of the thirty (30) and became their leader, but he was not included in those three who_were brave.

20 Ne duen pad man-e mabulut ne etew ne si Binayas ne matig-Kabsiil ne anak ni Huyada. Masulug ka neyimu rin ne mabantug ne himu. Nakapatey sikandin te daruwa ne mabbantug ne bahani ne matig-Muwab. Te timpu te tingmaagsil, migseled sikandin diye te lungag wey nekeyimatey sikandin te liyun diye. 21 Ne nakapatey sikandin te mateles ne lukes ne Ihiptuhanen. Minsan miggehen-gen ka Ihiptuhanen te kalawit piru miggendiyaan sikandin ni Binayas ne mig-uyan de te tuked wey in-ahew rin e ka kalawit, wey in-uney~rin e himatayi te kalawit din ded. 22 Seeye ka inggimu ni Binayas ne anak ni Huyada. Ne neyimu e sikandin ne iling kabantug te tatelu ne me bahani. 23 Sikandin ka subla ne mabantug du te Tatelu ne Pulu ne me duma rin, piru ware sikandin nakalagkes kandan. Ne inggimu sikandin ni Dabid ne pangulu te me talagbantey rin.

20 And there was still other fierce man who was Binayas from_Kabsiil the child of Huyada. He did many famous acts. He killed two famous warriors from_Muwab. At the time of cold_season, he entered there in a hole and he also killed a lion there. 21 And he killed a good_looking Ihiptuhanon man. Even_though the Ihiptuhanon was holding a spear but Binayas went to him carrying a staff and he snatched his spear, and he killed him with just his very_own spear. 22 That was what_ Binayas child of Huyada _did. And he became like the honor of the three warriors. 23 He became more famous/honored that his Thirty companions, but he wasn't included with_them. And Dabid made him leader of his guards.

Ka pegseel ni Dabid te keet-etawan

The counting of the people by Dabid

(1 Kru 21:1‑27)

(1 Chr 21:1‑27)

241 Ne nabelu e man-e amana ka Magbebaye ne Manama te me matig-Israil, wey impeparusaan din sikandan ki Dabid. Ne ingkahiyan din si Dabid, “Ipasinsus nu te me upisyal nu ka langun ne matig-Israil wey matig-Huda.” 2 Purisu ingkahiyan ni Dabid si Huwab wey ka me pangulu te me sundalu, “Hendiyei niyu ka langun ne tribu te Israil—puun te Dan peendiye te intiru ne Birsiba[fn] wey seela niyu ka me lukes ne eleg e ne egkeyimu ne sundalu eyew egkanengnengan ku ka kasulug dan.”

241 And the Lord God was_ very _angry again at the (ones) from_Israil, and he caused_ Dabid _to_punish them. And the Lord God said, “Caused_your(sg)_officials_to_take_a_census to all the (ones) from_Israil and the (ones) from_Huda.” 2 Therefore Huwab the leaders of the soldiers was_told by Dabid, “Go(pl) to all the tribes of Israil—from Dan to the entire Birsiba[fn] and count(pl) the males who are ok for becoming soldiers so_that I will_know their number.”

3 Piru migtabak si Huwab, “Meupiya perem ke egpamasuluhen te Magbebaye ne Manama te mahatus (100) ne lupi ka kasulug te keet-etawan nu kuntee, wey meupiya perem ke egkakita nu seini. Piru mahal ne Hari, mania te igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen seini?” 4 Piru impatuman iya te Hari engki Huwab wey te me pangulu te sundalu ka suhu din. Purisu miggipanew e si Huwab wey ka me pangulu te me sundalu eyew te pegsinsus te keet-etawan te Israil.

3 But Huwab answered, “It would_be better if the Lord God increases the number of your(sg) people by one hundred (100) fold now/today, and good [wishfully] if you(sg) could see this. But Honored King, why do you(sg) want to do this?” 4 But Huwab and the leaders of the soldiers were indeed made_to_obey his command. Therefore Huwab and the leaders of the soldiers went in_to_census the people of Israil.

5 Ne miglapas sikandan te Hurdan wey migbunsud e sikandan ka egsinsus puun te Aruwir wey puun te siyudad ne diye te elat-elat te napu. Ne puun diye, miggendiyad e sikandan te Gad wey diye te Hasir. 6 Ne migginguma sikandan diye te Gilyad wey diye te Kadis diye te tane te Hitihanen. Ne migginguma sikandan diye te Dan, wey migpabulus peendiye te Sidun. 7 Ne miggendiyad sikandan te siyudad ne Tiru ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu wey diye te langun ne siyudad te me Hibihanen wey me Kanaanen. Ne nataman, miggendiyad sikandan te Birsiba diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te Huda. 8 Peglihad te siyam ne bulan wey daruwa ne pulu (20) ne aldew, te nalingut dan e ka intiru ne nasud, mig-uli e sikandan diye te Hirusalim. 9 Ne ingguhud ni Huwab diye te Hari ka kasuluhan te me etew ne eleg e ne egkeyimu ne sundalu: ne due walu ne gatus ne libu (800,000) ne maagsik ne me lukes diye te Israil ne eleg e ne egkeyimu ne sundalu, wey lalimma ne gatus ne libu (500,000) ka diye te Huda.

5 And they crossed the Hurdan and they began to_census from Aruwir and from the city that's in the middle of the plain. And from there, they went to Gad and there to Hasir. 6 And they arrived there at Gilyad and at Kadis in the land of the Hitihanons. And they arrived there at Dan, and continue towards Sidun. 7 And they went to the city of Tiru that is fenced by a high and thick stone and to all the cities of the Hibihanons and Kanaanons. And then, they went to Birsiba which is in South (LIT right_side of crosswise to the sunrise) of Huda. 8 After nine months and twenty (20) days, when they had encircled the entire nation, they returned_home to Hirusalim. 9 And Huwab informed the king the number of the people ok for becoming soldier(s): there_were eight hundred thousand (800,000) energetic men in Israil ok for becoming soldiers, and five hundred thousand (500,000) in Huda.

10 Piru nekegsendit si Dabid te neimpusan din te egpaseel ka me etew. Ne ingkahiyan ni Dabid ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Dakel ka sale ku tenged te inggimu ku. Ne kuntee egpeyid-u-hid-u a ubag ne egpasayluwen a nikeykew se suluhuanen nu su keungelan iya ka neyimu ku.”

10 But Dabid regretted when he finished caused_to_count the people. And Dabid told the Lord God, “I have big sin due to what_ I _did. And now/today I plead [embarrassedly/please] that I your(sg) servant be_forgiven by_you(sg) for what_ I _have_done is indeed foolish.”

11 Te peggimata ni Dabid te seup ne maselem, impanengneng e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Gad ne prupita ni Dabid te miggenendue, 12 “Hendiyei nu si Dabid wey kahii nu, ‘Seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama: egbehayan ku sikeykew te tatelu ne eg-alaman. Alam ka te sabeka kayi wey eggimuwen ku seini due te keykew.’ ” 13 Purisu miggendiyaan e ni Gad si Dabid wey mig-insaan, “Hendei kayi te tatelu ka eg-alamen nu ne igdusa te Magbebaye ne Manama keykew? Tatelu[fn] naa ne leg-un ne bitil kayi te nasud nu, wey ke tatelu naa ne bulan ne egpakapalpallahuy ka puun te pegpanlupug keykew te me kuntere nu, wey ke tatelu naa ne aldew ne karereetan kayi te nasud nu? Na kuntee, sumsumana nu ke nekey ka igtabak ku te migsuhu keddi.”

11 When Dabid woke the next morning, the Lord God informed Dabid's prophet Gad going, 12 “Go(sg) to Dabid and say(sg) to him, ‘This is what_ the Lord God _says: I will_give you(sg) three choices. Choose(sg) one of these and I will_do it to you(sg).’ ” 13 Therefore Gad went to Dabid and asked, “Which of these three will_ you(sg) _choose that the Lord God will_punish you(sg) (with)? Three[fn] years of famine here in your(sg) nation, or three months of fleeing_repeatedly from your(sg) enemies chasing you(sg), or the destruction of your(sg) nation for three days? So now, think(sg) what I'm going to answer to the (one who) commanded me.”

14 Ne migtabak si Dabid, “Amana a nalaggew. Piru meupiya pad ke egdusaan ki te Magbebaye ne Manama du te etew ka egdusa kanta su hiid-uwen ma amana sikandin.”

14 And Dabid answered, “I'm very troubled. But it's better if we(incl) are_punished by the Lord God rather than people punishing us(incl) because he's very merciful.”

15 Purisu impeuyanan te Magbebaye ne Manama te karereetan ka Israil, puun te maselem taman te ingkerew ne aldew. Ne due pitu ne pulu ne libu (70,000) ne etew ne migpatey puun te Dan peendiye te Birsiba. 16 Te egdereetan e perem te panalihan ka Hirusalim, nekegsendit e ka Magbebaye ne Manama te karereetan ne neyitabu wey migkahiyan din ka panalihan ne migdereet te me etew, “Eleg e! Peen-enengi nud sika se eggimuwen nu.” Te seeye ne timpu, diye te diekanan te trigu ni Arawuna ne kabuhalan ni Hibus ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

15 Therefore the Lord God sent destruction to Israil, from morning until the scheduled day. And there were seventy thousand (70,000) people that died(pl) from Dan until Birsiba. 16 When a/the angel almost destroy the Hirusalim, the Lord God regretted the destruction that had happened and he told the angel that destroyed people, “That's enough! Stop(sg) that what_ you(sg) _are_doing.” At that time, the angel of the Lord God was there at the wheat treading_place of Arawuna the descendants of Hibus.

17 Ne nakita ni Dabid ka panalihan ne migdereet te me etew wey migkahiyan din ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Sikeddi ka nakasale; sikeddi ka nekeyimu te mareet. Piru nekey ka neyimu te seini se me etew? Ware sale dan iling te me karniru. Sikeddi ka duseyi nu wey ka pamilya ku.”

17 And Dabid saw the angel that destroyed people and he said to the Lord God, “I'm the (one who) have_sinned; I'm the (one who) have done bad/evil. But what did these people do? They have_no sin like sheep(pl). I'm the (one) you(sg) (should) punish and my family.”

18 Te seeye ne aldew, miggendiye si Gad ki Dabid wey migkahi, “Takereg ka diye te diekanan te trigu ni Arawuna ne kabuhalan ni Hibus wey himu ka te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad diye para te Magbebaye ne Manama.” 19 Ne intuman ni Dabid ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama sumale te ingkahi ni Gad kandin. 20 Te pegpantew ni Arawuna, nakita rin si Dabid wey ka me etew rin ne egpeendiye te kandin. Ne migligwang si Arawuna wey miglangkeb diye te tane diye te tangkaan ni Dabid isip pegtahud kandin. 21 Ne migkahi si Arawuna, “Mahal ne Hari, mania te miggendini ka keddi te suluhuanen nu?”

18 On that day, Gad went to Dabid and said, “Ascend(sg) to the wheat treading_place of Arawuna the descendants of Hibus and make an altar for sacrifice to burn_on there for the Lord God.” 19 And Dabid obeyed what_ the Lord God _commanded according to what_ Gad _had_told him. 20 On Arawuna's looking_around, he saw Dabid and his people going_there to him. And Arawuna exited and bowed_low to the ground in front of Dabid as (a way of) respecting him. 21 And Arawuna said, “Honored king, why did you(sg) come_here to me your(sg) servant?”

Ne migtabak si Dabid, “Miggendini a eyew te pegbeli te diekanan nu te trigu eyew eggimuwan ku te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad para te Magbebaye ne Manama, eyew egkasanggel e ka karereetan.”

And Dabid answered, “I came_here in_order for buying your(sg) wheat treading_place so_that I can make_here an altar where_ the sacrifices _be_burned for the Lord God, so_that the destruction will_stop.”

22 Ne ingkahiyan ni Arawuna ka Hari, “Ahalen ne Hari, kua nu ka minsan nekey ne igkahale nu wey ihalad nu. Due me baka seini para igpanubad ne egtutungen, wey due degma kayu ne kasangkapan te pegdiriek, wey me yuggu te baka ne egkahamit ne igtemeg.” 23 Igbehey re seeye se langun ni Arawuna diye te Hari wey ingkahiyan din sikandin, “Egdawaten perem ka igpanubad nu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne iyan ka Manama nu.”

22 And Arawuna told the king, “Master king, take(sg) whatever pleases you(sg) and offer(sg) (it). There are these cows for sacrificing by burning, and there are also wooden equipments for treading, and yokes for cows that can be used to_be_make_a_fire.” 23 And Arawuna just gave all that to the king and he said to him, “May your(sg) sacrifice be accepted by the Lord God who is your(sg) God.”

24 Piru ingkahiyan te Hari si Arawuna, “Kene, egbeliyen ku seini! Kena a egpanubad te Magbebaye ne Manama ne iyan ka Manama ku te igpanubad ne egtutungen ne ware ku bayari.” Purisu imbeli ni Dabid te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne timman ne seleppi ne pelata ka diekanan te trigu wey ka me baka. 25 Ne miggimu en iya si Dabid te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad diye para te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne migpanubad e sikandin te igpanubad ne egtutungen wey te me igpanubad para te keupianan. Ne intabak e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me peg-ampu ni Dabid para te nasud, wey naawe e ka karereetan diye te Israil.

24 But the king said to Arawuna, “No, I will_buy this! I won't sacrifice to the Lord God who is my God a sacrifice by burning that I haven't paid_for.” Therefore Dabid bought the treading_place for wheat and the cows for fifty (50) pieces of silver money. 25 And Dabid indeed made an altar where_ the sacrifices _be_burned there for the Lord God. And he sacrificed a burnt sacrifice and sacrifices for peace/prosperity. And the Lord God answered the prayers of Dabid for the nation, and the destruction was_removed from Israil.
